name: 青堀温泉
location: 千葉県 富津市
sales_point: 富津岬の付け根、小糸川沿いにある温泉地。海水浴や潮干狩りなどの行楽のの足場に好適。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located along the Koito River at the base of Futtsu Cape, ideal for beach activities and clam digging.

name: 安房温泉
location: 千葉県 安房郡鋸南町
sales_point: 鋸山南方、国道127号線沿いに位置する閑静な温泉地。風光明媚な環境で保養・休養に好適。
review_summary: Guests mention this inn offers delicious and fresh seafood, including sashimi boat platters, abalone, and grilled dishes, with generous portions. They also highlight the attentive and friendly staff, who provide excellent service and hospitality. Visitors appreciate the relaxing, nostalgic atmosphere and the clean, spacious Japanese-style rooms.
sales_point_en: A quiet hot spring area located south of Nokogiriyama along National Route 127, perfect for relaxation in a scenic environment.

name: 粟斗温泉
location: 千葉県 鴨川市
sales_point: 上待崎川沿いに位置する温泉地。山あいの静かな環境にあり、保養・休養に好適。森林浴・ハイキング・川釣りなども楽しめる。
review_summary:
Visitors say this hot spring offers soft, "torotoro" water with a sulfur scent that leaves skin smooth, and features a spacious rest area. They also highlight the availability of cold chai, free use of a large common room, and friendly resident dogs and cats.

Some reviews mention the entrance fee for the facilities can be expensive.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area situated along the Kamimachi River, in a tranquil mountain setting, ideal for recuperation and relaxation. Enjoy forest bathing, hiking, and river fishing.

name: 栗又温泉
location: 千葉県 夷隅郡大多喜町
sales_point: 養老川上流河畔に位置する温泉地。房総半島一の粟又の滝を見ながら入浴できる露天風呂は格別。
review_summary:
Visitors say this onsen offers a beautiful open-air bath with stunning views of nature and a smooth, skin-softening water quality. They also highlight the friendly staff and the delicious soba noodles and tempura available at the dining area.

Other reviews mention the shower water pressure can be weak.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located along the upper reaches of the Yoro River, featuring an exceptional outdoor bath with views of the famous Awamata Falls.

name: 飯岡温泉
location: 千葉県 海上郡飯岡町
sales_point: 波静かな飯岡海水浴場に面した温泉地。東南には刑部岬の断崖を仰ぎ、眺望が良い。海水浴や釣りを楽しめる。
review_summary:
Guests mention this hotel offers delicious breakfast buffets with local specialties like shirasu and tuna, and features a unique, warming black hot spring bath. They also highlight the beautiful ocean views, free drink bar, and convenient access to nearby shops.

Other reviews mention the Wi-Fi can be slow.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area facing the calm Iio Beach, with great views of the cliffs of Gyobuzaki to the southeast. Enjoy beach activities and fishing.

name: 飯岡ラジウム温泉
location: 千葉県 旭市
sales_point: 波静かな飯岡海水浴場に面した温泉地。東南には刑部岬の断崖を仰ぎ、眺望が良い。海水浴や釣りを楽しめる。
review_summary:
People say this natural hot spring features a wide variety of baths, including spacious open-air and indoor options, and a large sauna, offering a relaxing experience with its unique, concentrated saline water.

Other reviews mention the showers can be difficult to use and the facility can be poorly maintained.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area facing the calm Iio Beach, with great views of the cliffs of Gyobuzaki to the southeast. Enjoy beach activities and fishing.

name: 石塚温泉
location: 千葉県 館山市
sales_point: 館山湾に面した温泉地。風光明媚な環境にある。日帰り入浴も出来る。
review_summary: People say this hotel offers delicious and high-quality Japanese cuisine, especially fresh sashimi and unique desserts, with many rooms featuring private open-air baths. Guests also highlight the warm and welcoming staff, who provide excellent service. They also mention the reasonable prices for the luxurious experience.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area facing Tateyama Bay, located in a scenic environment. Day-use bathing is also available.

name: 岩井温泉
location: 千葉県 南房総市
sales_point: 南房総の岩井海岸の近くに位置する温泉地。海岸は遠浅が続き美しく、関東有数の海水浴場として知られている。夏場は海水浴客で賑わう。
review_summary:
Guests mention this condominium-style hotel offers spacious, clean rooms with full kitchens and cooking utensils, plus a large communal hot spring bath with ocean and Mount Fuji views. They also highlight the delicious, homemade breakfast buffet and the helpful, friendly staff.

Some reviews mention the building can be old and poorly maintained.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located near Iwai Beach in Minamiboso. The beach is known for its beautiful shallow waters and is one of the top swimming spots in Kanto, bustling with visitors in summer.

name: 岩婦温泉
location: 千葉県 南房総市
sales_point: 南総里見八犬伝ゆかりの富山、岩婦湖畔に位置する温泉地。山に囲まれた静かな環境にあり、療養に好適。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located by Lake Iwafu, associated with the Nanso Satomi Hakkenden. It is in a quiet mountain setting, ideal for recuperation.

name: 鵜原温泉
location: 千葉県 勝浦市
sales_point: 太平洋岸に面する勝浦市に位置する温泉地。県下屈指の漁場で獲れる新鮮な海の幸が楽しめる。
review_summary: Guests mention this inn offers unique cave and tunnel baths, providing a distinctive and adventurous bathing experience. They also highlight the delicious and abundant fresh seafood, including local specialties like namero and splendid kinmedai. Visitors appreciate the warm hospitality and attentive staff, who ensure a comfortable and relaxing stay.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located in Katsuura City, facing the Pacific Ocean. Enjoy fresh seafood from one of the best fishing grounds in the prefecture.

name: 勝浦温泉
location: 千葉県 勝浦市
sales_point: 勝浦市の北部、国道297号線の近くに位置する温泉地。オートキャンプ場や釣り堀などが併設されている。
review_summary:
People say this hot spring has a unique, brown, and slippery water quality that leaves skin feeling smooth. They also highlight the delicious and generously portioned meals, including local specialties like Katsuura Tantanmen, and the friendly staff.

Other reviews mention the bathing area can be small and crowded.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located in the northern part of Katsuura City, near National Route 297, featuring an auto camping site and fishing pond.

name: 勝浦うばら温泉
location: 千葉県 勝浦市
sales_point: 黒潮が北上する太平洋岸に面する勝浦市に位置する温泉地。県下屈指の漁場で獲れる新鮮な海の幸が楽しめる。
review_summary: Guests mention this inn offers unique cave and tunnel baths, providing a distinctive and adventurous bathing experience. They also highlight the delicious and abundant fresh seafood, including local specialties like namero and splendid kinmedai. Visitors appreciate the warm hospitality and attentive staff, who ensure a comfortable and relaxing stay.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located in Katsuura City, facing the Pacific Ocean where the Kuroshio current flows north. Enjoy fresh seafood from one of the best fishing grounds in the prefecture.

name: 亀山温泉
location: 千葉県 君津市
sales_point: 千葉県下最大のダム湖、亀山湖畔に位置する温泉地。湯量が豊富で効能も高い。釣り、プール、テニスも楽しみことができ、家族連れに好適。
review_summary: People say this hotel offers a unique chocolate-colored hot spring that leaves skin smooth and warm, along with delicious and beautifully presented meals. They also highlight the exceptional hospitality and attentive staff, who are particularly welcoming and helpful for families with babies and young children. Guests mention the serene lakeside location provides a relaxing atmosphere and beautiful views.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located by Lake Kameyama, the largest dam lake in Chiba Prefecture. It has abundant hot water and high efficacy. Enjoy fishing, a pool, and tennis, making it suitable for families.

name: 鴨川温泉
location: 千葉県 鴨川市
sales_point: 南房総鴨川海岸に位置する温泉地。太平洋に面した露天風呂から四季折々の海原を眺望できる。鴨川シーワールドが近い。
review_summary: People say this hotel offers rooms with private open-air baths and stunning ocean views, along with delicious and abundant seafood dishes like abalone and local splendid alfonsino. They also highlight the complimentary drinks available in the lounge and sky lounge. Guests mention the attentive staff and the quiet, relaxing atmosphere, making it ideal for special occasions.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located on the coast of Kamogawa in Minamiboso. Enjoy seasonal views of the ocean from the outdoor baths facing the Pacific. Close to Kamogawa Sea World.

name: 吉祥龍神の湯温泉
location: 千葉県 館山市
sales_point: 相浜海水浴場の南峰に位置する温泉地。すぐ近くが漁港や海水浴場になっており、水と緑の豊かな環境になっている。日帰り入浴可。
review_summary: Guests mention this inn offers delicious and voluminous meals, including fresh seafood and roast beef, with many highlighting the excellent desserts. They also appreciate the clean rooms and the relaxing hot spring baths. Others say the staff provides warm and attentive service, making for a pleasant and restful stay.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located on the southern peak of Aihama Beach, close to a fishing port and beach, in a rich environment of water and greenery. Day-use bathing is available.

name: 小糸川温泉
location: 千葉県 君津市
sales_point: 三島湖の南方約10キロ、小糸川清流沿いに位置する温泉地。静かで老人保養向け。
review_summary:
People say this onsen features a unique, dark "kuroyu" (black hot spring water) that leaves skin feeling smooth and moisturized. They also highlight the relaxing atmosphere and the availability of a spacious tatami-matted rest area.

Some reviews mention the showers can be unreliable.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located about 10 kilometers south of Mishima Lake, along the clear stream of Koito River. It is quiet and suitable for elderly recuperation.

name: 古原屋の湯温泉
location: 千葉県 館山市
sales_point: 石塚温泉のすぐ近くに位置する温泉地。館山湾を望む眺望の良い環境にある。沖ノ島、西岬海水浴場が近い。ビジネスや長期滞在も可。
review_summary:
People say this public bathhouse offers a variety of baths, including open-air and carbonated baths, and appreciate that towels, bath amenities, and loungewear are included in the fee. They also highlight the spacious relaxation areas with manga, delicious local seafood dishes, and the clean facilities.

Other reviews mention the admission can be expensive.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located very close to Ishizuka Onsen, with good views overlooking Tateyama Bay. Close to Okinoshima and Nishi Misaki Beach. Suitable for business and long-term stays.

name: 小湊温泉
location: 千葉県 鴨川市
sales_point: 日蓮上人ゆかりの寺、誕生寺の入口に位置する温泉地。外房観光の拠点に好適。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located at the entrance of Daishinji Temple, associated with Nichiren Shonin. Ideal as a base for sightseeing in the Outer Boso region.

name: サンランド温泉
location: 千葉県 館山市
sales_point: 館山カントリークラブゴルフ場の西方、平砂浦沿いに位置する温泉地。海の眺望が良く、夏は海水浴客に人気。
review_summary:
People say this public bathhouse offers a variety of baths, including open-air and carbonated baths, and appreciate that towels, bath amenities, and loungewear are included in the fee. They also highlight the spacious relaxation areas with manga, delicious local seafood dishes, and the clean facilities.

Other reviews mention the admission can be expensive.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located west of Tateyama Country Club Golf Course, along Hinasawa. It offers great ocean views and is popular with beachgoers in summer.

name: しあわせ温泉
location: 千葉県 南房総市
sales_point: 千倉温泉の南、川口漁港近くに位置する温泉地。海が客室から一望できる。海水浴、釣り客等で賑わう。鮮魚料理のグレードは高い。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located south of Chikura Onsen, near Kawaguchi Fishing Port. Enjoy ocean views from the guest rooms. Bustling with beachgoers and fishing enthusiasts, known for high-quality fresh seafood.

name: しおさい温泉
location: 千葉県 館山市
sales_point: 館山市の北方、船形漁港に臨む温泉地。那古、西浜海水浴場の真ん中にあるゆったり温泉と海の幸が楽しめる。
review_summary: Visitors say this onsen features a wide variety of spacious baths, including hot, warm, and cool options, along with a sauna and open-air baths. They also highlight the clean and well-maintained facilities, including the changing rooms and resting areas. Guests mention the friendly staff and the excellent value for the price, especially for the quality of the natural hot spring water.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located north of Tateyama City, overlooking Funagata Fishing Port. Enjoy a relaxing onsen experience and fresh seafood between Nako and Nishihama beaches.

name: 潮の湯温泉
location: 千葉県 銚子市
sales_point: 魚と醤油の名産の町として知られる銚子の犬吠埼に位置する温泉地。風光明媚な環境にあり、海沿いの展望台の眺望が良い。
review_summary:
Visitors say this natural hot spring offers open-air baths with expansive ocean views and a unique "fossil seawater" rich in sodium and calcium chloride. They also highlight the polite staff, complimentary towels, and free massage chairs in the relaxation area.

Some reviews mention the decor can be dated.
sales_point_en: Located in Inubosaki, known for its fish and soy sauce, this hot spring area offers a picturesque environment with great views from the seaside observation deck.

name: 七里川温泉
location: 千葉県 君津市
sales_point: 小櫃川上流に位置する温泉地。閑静な山の緑に囲まれた一軒宿で保養・静養に好適。
review_summary:
People say this onsen offers natural, free-flowing sulfur hot springs with comfortable temperatures for long soaks, and delicious charcoal-grilled dishes cooked over an irori hearth. Visitors also highlight the numerous friendly cats roaming freely, providing a unique and relaxing experience.

Some reviews mention the air can be smoky.
sales_point_en: A tranquil hot spring area situated upstream of the Obitsu River, surrounded by serene mountain greenery, ideal for relaxation and recuperation.

name: 白岩温泉
location: 千葉県 鴨川市
sales_point: 石尊山南側山麓、天津小湊町最北部に位置する温泉地。効能が高い硫黄の湯は秘湯と言われている。
sales_point_en: Located at the southern foot of Ishison Mountain in the northernmost part of Amatsu-Kominato Town, this hot spring is known for its highly effective sulfur waters, often referred to as a hidden gem.

name: 白子温泉
location: 千葉県 長生郡白子町
sales_point: 九十九里南部の白子町に位置する温泉地。白子海岸を一望できて風光明媚な環境にある。砂風呂が楽しめる。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located in Shirako Town in the southern part of Kujukuri, offering scenic views of Shirako Beach and the enjoyment of sand baths.

name: 白浜温泉
location: 千葉県 南房総市
sales_point: 白浜海岸から少し内陸部に入った静かな山あいに位置する温泉地。太平洋を一望できる眺望の良さと新鮮な海の幸が人気。
review_summary:
People say this hotel offers great value with ocean view rooms, delicious all-you-can-eat seafood BBQ for dinner, and a wide variety of breakfast options, all complemented by friendly staff.

Other reviews mention the rooms can be poorly maintained and there can be a musty odor.
sales_point_en: Nestled a bit inland from Shirahama Beach, this quiet hot spring area boasts great views of the Pacific Ocean and is popular for its fresh seafood.

name: 白浜飯田屋温泉
location: 千葉県 南房総市
sales_point: 房総半島南端の白浜海岸付近に位置する温泉地。通年温暖な気候で海と花に囲まれた南国ムードが漂う。太平洋を一望できる眺望の良さと新鮮な海の幸が人気。
sales_point_en: Located near Shirahama Beach at the southern tip of the Boso Peninsula, this hot spring area enjoys a warm climate year-round, surrounded by sea and flowers, with stunning views of the Pacific Ocean and fresh seafood.

name: 白浜野嶋温泉
location: 千葉県 南房総市

review_summary:
People say this hotel offers delicious seafood, including all-you-can-eat grilled turban shell, scallops, and shrimp, along with fresh sashimi and made-to-order tempura. Guests also highlight the excellent value, ocean views, and friendly, attentive staff.

Other reviews mention the building can be dated.
sales_point_en: Situated near Shirahama Beach at the southern tip of the Boso Peninsula, this hot spring area features a warm climate year-round, surrounded by sea and flowers, with great views of the Pacific Ocean and fresh seafood.

review_summary:
People say this hotel offers excellent value with delicious all-you-can-eat crab, fresh seafood for grilling, and tasty Chinese dishes, all complemented by friendly staff.

Other reviews mention the facilities can be poorly maintained and neglected.
sales_point_en: Located near Shirahama Beach at the southern tip of the Boso Peninsula, this hot spring area enjoys a warm climate year-round, surrounded by sea and flowers, with stunning views of the Pacific Ocean and fresh seafood.

location: 千葉県 勝浦市
sales_point: 黒潮が北上する太平洋岸に面する勝浦市に位置する温泉地。県下屈指の漁場で獲れる新鮮な海の幸が楽しめる。
review_summary:
People say this hot spring has a unique, brown, and slippery water quality that leaves skin feeling smooth. They also highlight the delicious and generously portioned meals, including local specialties like Katsuura Tantanmen, and the friendly staff.

Other reviews mention the bathing area can be small and crowded.
sales_point_en: Located in Katsuura City facing the Pacific coast where the Kuroshio current flows north, this hot spring area offers fresh seafood from one of the best fishing grounds in the prefecture.

name: 曽呂温泉
location: 千葉県 鴨川市
sales_point: ＪＲ太美駅の西方約4キロ、太美海岸を一望する丘陵地に位置する温泉地。ひなびた雰囲気を持つ歴史の永い湯治場。湯はコーヒー色をしている。
sales_point_en: Situated about 4 kilometers west of JR Taimi Station, this hot spring area is located on a hill overlooking Taimi Beach, known for its rustic atmosphere and long history. The water has a coffee color.

name: 館山湯元温泉
location: 千葉県 館山市
sales_point: ＪＲ館山駅の北方約2キロに位置する温泉地。海まで1分という宿では、館山湾でとれる魚を味わうことが出来る。
review_summary: Guests mention this inn offers delicious and voluminous meals, including fresh seafood and roast beef, with many highlighting the excellent desserts. They also appreciate the clean rooms and the relaxing hot spring baths. Others say the staff provides warm and attentive service, making for a pleasant and restful stay.
sales_point_en: Located about 2 kilometers north of JR Tateyama Station, this hot spring area is just a minute from the sea, where you can enjoy fish caught in Tateyama Bay.

name: 千倉温泉
location: 千葉県 南房総市
sales_point: 千倉駅の南、千倉漁港の近くに位置する温泉地。源頼朝ゆかりの温泉地と伝えられ、歴史がある。新鮮な魚介類の料理と石灯籠がある大浴場が自慢。
review_summary:
Guests mention this inn offers delicious and abundant meals, especially fresh seafood, local beef, and unique dishes like abalone and leaf chili. They also highlight the excellent hot springs, including a warm main bath and a cooler medicinal bath, and the attentive, friendly staff.

Other reviews mention the rooms can be dated.
sales_point_en: Located south of Chikura Station, near Chikura Fishing Port, this hot spring area is said to be associated with Minamoto no Yoritomo and has a rich history. It boasts fresh seafood dishes and a large bath with stone lanterns.

name: 千倉海岸温泉
location: 千葉県 南房総市
sales_point: 温暖な気候と美しい花畑や海辺で知られる千倉町北部の瀬戸浜海水浴場前に位置する温泉地。一年中春のような海辺で太平洋がもたらす海の幸を堪能できる。
review_summary:
Guests mention this inn offers delicious and abundant meals, especially fresh seafood, local beef, and unique dishes like abalone and leaf chili. They also highlight the excellent hot springs, including a warm main bath and a cooler medicinal bath, and the attentive, friendly staff.

Other reviews mention the rooms can be dated.
sales_point_en: Located in front of Setohama Beach in the northern part of Chikura Town, known for its warm climate and beautiful flower fields. Enjoy the seafood brought by the Pacific Ocean in a spring-like seaside atmosphere year-round.

sales_point_en: Located in front of Setohama Beach in the northern part of Chikura Town, known for its warm climate and beautiful flower fields. Enjoy the seafood brought by the Pacific Ocean in a spring-like seaside atmosphere year-round.

review_summary: Visitors say this beach offers clear, beautiful water and a mix of sandy and rocky areas perfect for磯遊び (rocky shore play) and shell collecting. They also highlight the calm waves, making it suitable for families with small children, and appreciate the free, ample parking, clean restrooms, and showers.
sales_point_en: Located in front of Setohama Beach in the northern part of Chikura Town, known for its warm climate and beautiful flower fields. Enjoy the seafood brought by the Pacific Ocean in a spring-like seaside atmosphere year-round.

name: 千倉元湯温泉
location: 千葉県 南房総市
sales_point: 温暖な気候と美しい花畑や海辺で知られる千倉町北部の瀬戸浜海水浴場前に位置する温泉地。一年中春のような海辺で太平洋がもたらす海の幸を堪能できる。
review_summary:
Guests mention this inn offers delicious and abundant meals, especially fresh seafood, local beef, and unique dishes like abalone and leaf chili. They also highlight the excellent hot springs, including a warm main bath and a cooler medicinal bath, and the attentive, friendly staff.

Other reviews mention the rooms can be dated.
sales_point_en: Located in front of Setohama Beach in the northern part of Chikura Town, known for its warm climate and beautiful flower fields. Enjoy the seafood brought by the Pacific Ocean in a spring-like seaside atmosphere year-round.

name: 鳴涛温泉
location: 千葉県 山武市
sales_point: 九十九里町北隣の成東町に位置する温泉地。南東2キロには九十九里浜、成東海岸海水浴場があり、美しい砂浜を一望できる。
sales_point_en: Located in Narutou Town, adjacent to Kujukuri Town. Just 2 kilometers southeast are Kujukuri Beach and Narutou Coast, offering beautiful sandy beach views.

name: 鋸山金谷温泉
location: 千葉県 富津市
sales_point: 久里浜からのフェリーが発着する浜金谷の海岸に位置する温泉地。鋸山観光や海水浴を楽しむ人々で賑わいを見せる。
review_summary:
Visitors say this hot spring offers stunning ocean views from its open-air baths, and features a unique brown, slightly viscous water quality. They also highlight the convenient on-site facilities, including restaurants and souvenir shops, and appreciate the complimentary towel service.

Other reviews mention the facilities can be poorly maintained.
sales_point_en: Located on the coast of Hamakanaya, where ferries from Kurihama arrive, this hot spring area is bustling with visitors enjoying sightseeing at Nokogiriyama and beach activities.

name: 富津温泉
location: 千葉県 富津市
sales_point: 東京湾に突き出た富津岬に位置する温泉地。
review_summary:
Visitors say this hot spring offers stunning ocean views from its open-air baths, and features a unique brown, slightly viscous water quality. They also highlight the convenient on-site facilities, including restaurants and souvenir shops, and appreciate the complimentary towel service.

Other reviews mention the facilities can be poorly maintained.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located at the tip of Futtsu Cape, protruding into Tokyo Bay.

name: 太海湯元温泉
location: 千葉県 鴨川市
sales_point: ＪＲ太美駅の南東側の海岸沿いに位置する温泉地。仁右衛門、サムライ、弁天島を望み眺望が良い。夏は海水浴、磯釣り客が多い。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located along the coast southeast of JR Taibi Station, offering great views of Niemon, Samurai, and Benten Island. Popular for summer beachgoers and fishing enthusiasts.

name: 不老山薬師温泉
location: 千葉県 館山市
sales_point: 国道410号線沿いに位置する温泉地。すぐ近くの安房自然村に源泉がある。根本海水浴場が近い
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located along National Route 410, with a source nearby at Awa Nature Village. Close to Nemoto Beach.

name: へいすけ温泉
location: 千葉県 南房総市
sales_point: 乙浦漁港のある乙浦地区近辺に位置する温泉地。塩浦名倉海水浴場を目の前に望み、眺望が良い。
review_summary: Guests mention this inn offers delicious and voluminous meals, especially fresh sashimi and local fish, along with a wide variety of free drinks and snacks in the lounge. They also highlight the clean and well-maintained facilities, including the renovated rooms and compact public baths. Visitors appreciate the attentive and friendly staff, noting their exceptional hospitality and helpfulness.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located near the Otsu fishing port, offering great views of Shiohura Nagura Beach.

name: 弁天温泉
location: 千葉県 南房総市
sales_point: 岩井海岸の南端に位置する温泉地。一日に数回色が変わる不思議な湯は、肌触りがとても滑らか。海を一望できる露天風呂と、とれたての魚介料理が楽しめる。
review_summary:
Guests mention this inn offers rare sulfur hot springs with rich mineral content and delicious, fresh seafood dishes like Ise ebi and abalone. They also highlight the stunning ocean views from the outdoor baths and the attentive staff.

Some reviews mention phone reservations can be difficult.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located at the southern end of Iwai Beach, featuring mysterious waters that change color several times a day and have a very smooth texture. Enjoy open-air baths with a view of the sea and fresh seafood dishes.

name: 三日月温泉
location: 千葉県 勝浦市
sales_point: 黒潮が北上する太平洋岸に面する勝浦市に位置する温泉地。県下屈指の漁場で獲れる新鮮な海の幸が楽しめる。
review_summary:
Guests consistently praise this hotel for its spacious, clean rooms that boast great ocean views. They also highlight the large indoor pool with free float rentals, the fresh seafood including all-you-can-eat salmon roe, and the complimentary alcoholic beverages.

Other reviews mention the buffet food can be disappointing.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located facing the Pacific coast where the Kuroshio current flows north, known for fresh seafood from one of the best fishing grounds in the prefecture.

name: 湊温泉
location: 千葉県 船橋市
sales_point: 船橋駅の南西約1キロの市街地に位置する温泉地。近隣の人々の憩いの場として好評。露天風呂有り。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located about 1 kilometer southwest of Funabashi Station, popular as a relaxation spot for local residents. Features an open-air bath.

name: 南館山温泉
location: 千葉県 館山市
sales_point: 館山市街から車で約10分、マリンスポーツのメッカ平砂浦海岸に面した小高い丘の上に位置する温泉地。南房総観光の拠点に好適。
review_summary:
People say this public bathhouse offers a variety of baths, including open-air and carbonated baths, and appreciate that towels, bath amenities, and loungewear are included in the fee. They also highlight the spacious relaxation areas with manga, delicious local seafood dishes, and the clean facilities.

Other reviews mention the admission can be expensive.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located on a small hill facing the marine sports mecca of Hinasura Beach, about a 10-minute drive from Tateyama City. Ideal as a base for sightseeing in Minamiboso.

name: 南房総白浜温泉
location: 千葉県 南房総市
sales_point: 白浜町の西端に位置する温泉地。ジャングル温泉と海を一望する露天風呂があるリゾート温泉。すぐ近くに根本海水浴場、オートキャンプ場があり、家族連れも楽しめる。
review_summary:
People say this hotel offers great value with ocean view rooms, delicious all-you-can-eat seafood BBQ for dinner, and a wide variety of breakfast options, all complemented by friendly staff.

Other reviews mention the rooms can be poorly maintained and there can be a musty odor.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located at the western end of Shirahama Town, featuring a resort hot spring with open-air baths overlooking a jungle hot spring and the sea. Close to Nemoto Beach and an auto camping site, making it family-friendly.

name: 宮下温泉
location: 千葉県 鴨川市
sales_point: 南房総鴨川海岸に位置する温泉地。太平洋に面した露天風呂から四季折々の海原を眺望できる。鴨川シーワールドが近い。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located on the Minamiboso Kamogawa coast, with open-air baths facing the Pacific Ocean, offering views of the sea throughout the seasons. Close to Kamogawa Sea World.

name: 元湯白浜温泉
location: 千葉県 南房総市
sales_point: 房総半島南端の白浜海岸付近に位置する温泉地。通年温暖な気候で海と花に囲まれた南国ムードが漂う。太平洋を一望できる眺望の良さと新鮮な海の幸が人気。
review_summary:
People say this hotel offers great value with ocean view rooms, delicious all-you-can-eat seafood BBQ for dinner, and a wide variety of breakfast options, all complemented by friendly staff.

Other reviews mention the rooms can be poorly maintained and there can be a musty odor.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located near Shirahama Beach at the southern tip of the Boso Peninsula. It has a warm climate year-round, surrounded by the sea and flowers, creating a tropical atmosphere. Known for its great views of the Pacific Ocean and fresh seafood.

name: 矢指ケ浦温泉
location: 千葉県 旭市
sales_point: 九十九里浜の矢指ヶ浦に位置する温泉地。景観の良い矢指ヶ浦海水浴場がすぐ近くにあり、夏場は家族連れなどで賑わう。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located at Yasugawaura on Kujukuri Beach, close to the scenic Yasugawaura Beach, which is bustling with families during the summer.

name: 湯場の原温泉
location: 千葉県 勝浦市
sales_point: 勝浦市街地を見おろす高台に位置する温泉地。緑に囲まれた自然の中にクアハウスがある。16種類の風呂が楽しめる。
review_summary: Guests mention this inn offers unique cave and tunnel baths, providing a distinctive and adventurous bathing experience. They also highlight the delicious and abundant fresh seafood, including local specialties like namero and splendid kinmedai. Visitors appreciate the warm hospitality and attentive staff, who ensure a comfortable and relaxing stay.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located on a hill overlooking Katsuura City, featuring a spa house surrounded by nature. Enjoy 16 different types of baths.

name: 養老渓谷温泉
location: 千葉県 夷隅郡大多喜町/市原市
sales_point: 春のヤマツツジや紅葉の景勝地、養老渓谷に位置する温泉地。のんびりとした雰囲気が漂い、静かな環境にある。釣りも楽しめる。市原市と大多喜町にまたがっている。
review_summary: Guests mention this inn offers delicious and satisfying meals, including unique dishes like fried horse mackerel, and features a private black-water hot spring bath that leaves skin smooth. They also highlight the reasonable prices and the attentive, kind staff.
city_ja: 夷隅郡大多喜町/市原市
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located in the scenic Yoro Valley, known for its spring azaleas and autumn leaves. It has a relaxed atmosphere and a quiet environment, with fishing opportunities. Spanning Ichihara City and Otaki Town.

name: ロマンの森温泉
location: 千葉県 君津市
sales_point: 小糸川の上流、豊英湖南端に近いロマンの森共和国内に位置する温泉地。キャンプ、アスレチック、テニス、ゴルフなど楽しめる。
review_summary:
People say this mountain theme park offers a variety of attractions for all ages, including forest athletics and a giant maze, with tasty food options and helpful staff.

Other reviews mention the price can be high for the offerings and the facilities can be poorly maintained.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located near the upper reaches of the Koito River, close to the southern end of Lake Toyohide, within the Roman no Mori Kyowa Country. Offers activities like camping, athletics, tennis, and golf.

name: 赤平川温泉
location: 埼玉県 秩父郡小鹿野町
review_summary:
People say this onsen has a smooth, skin-softening water quality and a wide variety of delicious local dishes, including soba and waraji katsu. They also highlight the clean facilities, spacious relaxation areas with hammocks, and reasonable prices.

Other reviews mention the facility can be early closing.

name: 大滝温泉
location: 埼玉県 秩父市
sales_point: 秩父最奥の大滝村落合地区の栗尾沢に位置する温泉地。秩父湖探勝や三峰山登山基地に最適。水と緑の豊かな自然郷。
review_summary:
People say this onsen has excellent quality hot spring water that leaves skin feeling smooth, and features both cypress and rock baths with scenic views of the river and surrounding nature. Visitors also appreciate the reasonable prices, the ability to relax in a non-crowded environment, and the convenient location within a roadside station.

Other reviews mention the facility can be dated.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located in the Kuriozawa area of Otaki Village, the innermost part of Chichibu. Ideal for exploring Chichibu Lake and as a base for climbing Mount Mitsumine. A rich natural environment with abundant water and greenery.

name: 柴原温泉
location: 埼玉県 秩父市
review_summary: Guests mention this ryokan offers delicious, hearty, and satisfying local cuisine, with many highlighting the seasonal wild herbs and mountain vegetables. They also appreciate the clean, relaxing hot springs, which leave skin feeling smooth. Visitors find the quiet atmosphere and attentive staff contribute to a peaceful and excellent value stay.

name: 大竜寺源泉温泉
location: 埼玉県 秩父郡小鹿野町
spa_quality: その他(メタほう酸の項で該当)
sales_point: 諏訪山東側山麓の山あいに位置する温泉地。豊かな自然に囲まれており、風光明媚な環境。登山基地としても好適。
spa_quality_en: その他(メタほう酸の項で該当)
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located in the mountains on the eastern slope of Suwa Mountain, surrounded by rich nature and offering a picturesque environment. Also suitable as a base for mountain climbing.

name: 秩父吉田温泉
location: 埼玉県 秩父市
spa_quality: ナトリウム―炭酸水素塩泉
review_summary: People say this hot spring facility offers a variety of baths, including spacious open-air options and a hot sauna with automatic löyly. They also highlight the reasonable prices, which include towel and loungewear rentals, and the availability of free drinks and massage chairs. Visitors appreciate the relaxing atmosphere, the beautiful Japanese garden, and the delicious local cuisine served at the restaurant.
spa_quality_en: ナトリウム―炭酸水素塩泉

name: 都幾川温泉
location: 埼玉県 比企郡ときがわ町
spa_quality: 強アルカリ性単純温泉
sales_point: 都幾川沿いに位置する温泉地。山あいの静かな環境にあり、休養・保養に好適。入浴すると肌がつるつるになると言われている。
review_summary: Guests mention this onsen features highly alkaline hot springs that leave skin feeling smooth, and they appreciate the private, reserved baths. They also highlight the delicious and beautifully presented kaiseki meals, which are prepared with seasonal ingredients. Others also say the staff provides attentive and warm hospitality, making for a relaxing and memorable experience.
spa_quality_en: 強アルカリ性単純温泉
sales_point_en: An onsen area located along the Toki River. It is in a quiet mountain environment, ideal for relaxation and recuperation. It is said that bathing here makes your skin smooth.

name: 四季の湯温泉
location: 埼玉県 熊谷市
spa_quality: ナトリウムー塩化物泉
sales_point: 武蔵丘陵に位置する温泉地。自然環境に恵まれている。近隣の人々の利用で賑わう。
spa_quality_en: ナトリウムー塩化物泉
sales_point_en: An onsen area located in the Musashi Hills, blessed with a natural environment. It is popular among local residents.

name: 中津川温泉
location: 埼玉県 秩父市
spa_quality: その他(鉄及びメタけい酸含有による規定泉)
sales_point: 甲武信岳の北東側山麓、中津川沿いに位置する温泉地。渓流釣りや森林浴が楽しめる。閑静な環境にあり、保養・静養に好適。
review_summary: People say this hot spring facility offers a variety of baths, including spacious open-air options and a hot sauna with automatic löyly. They also highlight the reasonable prices, which include towel and loungewear rentals, and the availability of free drinks and massage chairs. Visitors appreciate the relaxing atmosphere, the beautiful Japanese garden, and the delicious local cuisine served at the restaurant.
spa_quality_en: その他(鉄及びメタけい酸含有による規定泉)
sales_point_en: An onsen area located along the Nakatsukawa River at the northeastern foot of Mount Kobushin. Enjoy stream fishing and forest bathing in a quiet environment, ideal for recuperation and relaxation.

name: 名栗温泉
location: 埼玉県 飯能市
spa_quality: 低張性アルカリ性冷鉱泉
sales_point: 奥武蔵と奥多摩の境にある棒ノ嶺の東側山麓に位置する温泉地。名栗川支流の河畔で、閑静な環境にある。近くには村営の日帰り温泉施設もある。
review_summary: Guests mention this hot spring ryokan offers excellent hot springs, including spacious public baths with scenic views and private baths. They also highlight the delicious and carefully prepared seasonal cuisine, with options for in-room dining. Visitors consistently praise the warm, attentive, and personalized service from the staff, making for a comfortable and memorable stay.
spa_quality_en: 低張性アルカリ性冷鉱泉
sales_point_en: An onsen area located at the eastern foot of Mount Bōnoyama, on the border of Oku Musashi and Oku Tama. It is situated by a tributary of the Naguri River in a tranquil environment. There is also a village-operated day-use onsen facility nearby.

name: 百観音温泉
location: 埼玉県 久喜市
review_summary: People say this hot spring facility offers excellent quality hot spring water, with many enjoying the variety of baths, including a stimulating 46-degree standing bath and a comfortable carbonated spring. They also highlight the reasonable prices and the convenience of the on-site dining options. Guests mention the friendly and helpful staff, and appreciate the ample free parking.

name: 百穴温泉
location: 埼玉県 比企郡吉見町
spa_quality: その他(メタほう酸の項で該当)
sales_point: 横穴古墳群の吉見百穴近くの滑川沿いに位置する温泉地。遠くに秩父連山を望むことができる。閑静な環境で、保養・休養に好適。
spa_quality_en: その他(メタほう酸の項で該当)
sales_point_en: An onsen area located along the Namikawa River near the Yoshimi Hyakuana burial mounds. You can see the Chichibu mountain range in the distance. It is in a quiet environment, suitable for recuperation and relaxation.

name: 丸山鉱泉
location: 埼玉県 秩父郡横瀬町
sales_point: 武甲山北東側山麓、横瀬川の支流沿いに位置する温泉地。山あいの静かな環境にあり、休養・保養に好適。秩父連山の登山基地にも便利。
review_summary:
People say this inn offers delicious, hearty meals, including wild boar and seasonal tempura, and features relaxing open-air baths with beautiful forest views. Guests also highlight the reasonable prices, attentive staff, and the option for convenient shuttle service.

Other reviews mention the older buildings can be cold.
sales_point_en: An onsen area located along a tributary of the Yokozegawa River at the northeastern foot of Mount Bukō. It is in a quiet mountain environment, ideal for relaxation and recuperation. Convenient as a base for climbing the Chichibu mountain range.

name: 両神薬師の湯温泉
location: 埼玉県 秩父郡小鹿野町
sales_point: 両神山東側山麓に位置する温泉地。自然豊かな山里にある湧く温泉地。両神国民休養地、四阿屋山などハイキングコースとしても人気。
review_summary:
People say this onsen has a smooth, skin-softening water quality and a wide variety of delicious local dishes, including soba and waraji katsu. They also highlight the clean facilities, spacious relaxation areas with hammocks, and reasonable prices.

Other reviews mention the facility can be early closing.
sales_point_en: An onsen area located at the eastern foot of Mount Ryōgami. It is a hot spring area rich in nature, popular for hiking routes such as Ryōgami National Recreation Area and Mount Shiraoya.

name: 赤滝温泉
location: 栃木県 矢板市
sales_point: 中川の河畔に位置する温泉地。上流600メートルに温泉名の由来となった赤滝がある。新緑・紅葉が美しい。
sales_point_en: An onsen area located along the banks of the Nakagawa River. The Akadaki waterfall, which is the origin of the onsen's name, is located 600 meters upstream. The fresh greenery and autumn leaves are beautiful.

name: 足尾温泉
location: 栃木県 日光市
sales_point: 銅山で有名な足尾町に位置する温泉地。山あいの閑静な環境にあり、保養・静養に好適。日光中禅寺湖方面の観光基地や、登山の基地にも向いている。
review_summary: People say this inn offers excellent alkaline hot springs with a "toro-toro" and "nuru-nuru" texture, leaving skin smooth, and features clean facilities with spacious rooms. Guests also highlight the delicious kaiseki-style meals, which use local ingredients, and the attentive staff. They also like the quiet, uncrowded atmosphere, making it ideal for relaxation.
sales_point_en: An onsen area located in Ashio Town, famous for its copper mines. It is in a quiet mountain environment, ideal for recuperation and relaxation. It is also suitable as a base for sightseeing in the Nikko and Lake Chuzenji area, as well as for climbing.

name: 芦野温泉
location: 栃木県 那須郡那須町
sales_point: 旧奥州街道芦野の里の自然の中の丘陵に開かれた温泉地。
review_summary: People say this onsen offers a variety of baths, including the highly effective and stimulating medicinal herb bath, the skin-softening Tsuru no Yu, and the skin-brightening Mera no Yu. Visitors also highlight the reasonable prices after 4 PM, the clean facilities, and the attentive staff. They also like the relaxing atmosphere and the delicious, affordable food available at the on-site restaurant.
sales_point_en: An onsen area opened in the hills of nature in the old Oshu Highway Ashino village.

name: 板室温泉
location: 栃木県 那須塩原市
sales_point: 那須連峰の西端、那珂川支流の湯川沿いに位置する温泉地。山峡の閑静な環境にあり、保養・療養に好適。国民保養温泉地に指定されている。
review_summary: People say this traditional Japanese inn offers delicious seasonal Japanese cuisine, including excellent grilled ayu, and features clean, renovated baths with natural hot spring water. Guests also highlight the quiet, art-filled atmosphere and the convenience of in-room dining for all meals. They also appreciate the attentive and warm service from the staff.
sales_point_en: An onsen area located along the Yukawa River, a tributary of the Nakagawa River, at the western edge of the Nasu mountain range. It is in a quiet mountain gorge, ideal for recuperation and therapy. It is designated as a national health resort.

name: 今市温泉
location: 栃木県 日光市
sales_point: 大谷川沿いに位置する温泉地。日光と鬼怒川の中間にあり、観光拠点に好適。交通の便がよい。
review_summary:
Visitors say this onsen offers a relaxing experience with smooth, skin-softening alkaline water, and appreciate the clean facilities, including a spacious rest area. They also highlight the friendly staff and reasonable prices, especially for a tourist area.

Other reviews mention it can be crowded.
sales_point_en: An onsen area located along the Otani River. It is conveniently located between Nikko and Kinugawa, making it a good base for sightseeing. It has good transportation access.

name: 大網（塩原温泉郷）
location: 栃木県 那須塩原市
sales_point: 塩原温泉郷の入口に位置する温泉地。300段ほどの階段を下りた箒川の河畔には、岩から湯が湧き出る野趣豊かな露天風呂がある。
review_summary: Guests mention this hot spring inn offers delicious meals, especially the robatayaki dinner, and a variety of excellent hot springs, including private open-air baths. They also highlight the attentive and friendly staff, who provide warm hospitality. Visitors appreciate the clean rooms and the peaceful atmosphere.
sales_point_en: An onsen area located at the entrance of the Shiobara Onsenkyo. There is a rustic outdoor bath where hot water springs from the rocks along the banks of the Hōki River, after descending about 300 steps.

name: 大田原温泉
location: 栃木県 大田原市
sales_point: 大田原市の東を流れる蛇尾川沿いに位置する温泉地。近くには桜の名所「城山公園」があり、釣りや散策を楽しむことができる。
review_summary:
People say this onsen features a wide variety of baths, including a silky smooth hot spring, electric bath, jet bath, and open-air bath, as well as spacious saunas. They also highlight the reasonable prices, especially on Wednesdays, and the delicious food.

Other reviews mention the facility can be crowded.
sales_point_en: An onsen area located along the Jaba River flowing east of Otawara City. Nearby is the famous cherry blossom spot 'Shiroyama Park', where you can enjoy fishing and strolling.

name: 大丸（那須高原温泉郷）
location: 栃木県 那須郡那須町
sales_point: 那須高原温泉郷のひとつ。茶臼岳の中腹、標高1250メートルの高地に位置する秘湯。豊富な湯量を誇り、温泉の流れが大露天風呂になっている。
review_summary: Visitors say this hot spring inn features a unique "river bath" open-air hot spring with abundant water flow, and many appreciate the provided bathing robes for comfortable mixed-gender bathing. They also highlight the high-quality, skin-softening spring water and the delicious meals, including local beef and fresh ingredients. Guests mention the staff are kind and helpful, and the overall atmosphere is clean and relaxing.
sales_point_en: One of the Nasu Kōgen Onsenkyo. A hidden hot spring located at an altitude of 1250 meters on the slope of Mount Chausudake. It boasts a rich supply of hot water, with the flow forming a large outdoor bath.

name: 奥塩原新湯（塩原温泉郷）
location: 栃木県 那須塩原市
sales_point: 日塩もみじライン沿いに位置する温泉地。塩原温泉郷の一角で、標高900メートルの高原にある秘湯。一帯に硫黄臭が漂う。スキー場が近い。
review_summary:
Guests mention this inn offers excellent quality, milky white sulfur hot springs, including private open-air baths that are available without reservation. They also highlight the delicious and plentiful in-room meals, along with the attentive and friendly staff.

Some reviews mention the building can be dated.
sales_point_en: An onsen area located along the Nikko Momiji Line. It is a hidden hot spring at an altitude of 900 meters in a corner of the Shiobara Onsenkyo. The area is filled with a sulfur smell. A ski resort is nearby.

name: 奥日光湯元温泉
location: 栃木県 日光市
sales_point: 奥日光の湯ノ湖北岸に位置する温泉地。標高1500メートルの高地にあり、白根山・温泉岳・三岳に囲まれた閑静な環境。日光最古の温泉。国民保養温泉地。
review_summary: Guests mention this ryokan offers exquisite, large rooms, each with its own private, genuine hot spring bath, and highlight the phenomenal, artfully arranged seasonal meals. They also appreciate the quiet, peaceful ambiance and the warm, attentive staff.
sales_point_en: An onsen area located on the northern shore of Lake Yunoko in Oku Nikko. It is situated at an altitude of 1500 meters, surrounded by Mount Shirane, Onsen-dake, and Mitsumata, in a quiet environment. It is the oldest onsen in Nikko and designated as a national health resort.

name: 小来川温泉
location: 栃木県 日光市
sales_point: 日光市街の南側に位置する、前日光高原にある温泉地。鹿沼市街のゴルフ場へのアクセスに便利。
sales_point_en: An onsen area located in the southern part of Nikko City, in the Maenikko Kōgen. It is conveniently located for access to golf courses in Kanuma City.

name: 柏倉温泉
location: 栃木県 栃木市
sales_point: 栃木駅の北西約7キロのゴルフ場に囲まれた場所に位置する温泉地。昔から獅子の水飲み場として有名で、山の動物達が体調を良くするため集って冷泉を飲んだと伝えられる。
review_summary:
Guests mention this inn offers clean, traditional Japanese-style rooms, some with private open-air baths, and delicious in-room dining featuring soba and yuba dishes. They also highlight the quiet atmosphere, the option to reserve the spacious public baths for private use, and the friendly staff.

Some reviews mention the bath facilities can be unused.
sales_point_en: Located about 7 kilometers northwest of Tochigi Station, this onsen is surrounded by a golf course. It has been famous since ancient times as a drinking spot for lions, where mountain animals are said to gather to drink the cold spring water for their health.

name: 加仁湯（奥鬼怒温泉郷）
location: 栃木県 日光市
sales_point: 奥鬼怒温泉郷のひとつ。鬼怒川の渓流沿いに位置する温泉地。原生林に囲まれ、自然環境が良い。大きな露天風呂がある。
review_summary: People say this onsen ryokan offers excellent quality hot spring water, with multiple outdoor baths featuring milky, sulfurous water. Guests mention the reasonable prices for a full Japanese ryokan experience, including tasty and healthy meals with local mountain vegetables. They also highlight the friendly and helpful staff, who provide great service.
sales_point_en: One of the Oku-Kinugawa hot springs, this onsen is situated along the Kinugawa River. Surrounded by primeval forests, it offers a great natural environment and features a large outdoor bath.

name: 上塩原（塩原温泉郷）
location: 栃木県 那須塩原市
sales_point: 箒川の上流の尾頭沢沿いに位置する温泉地。塩原温泉郷の一角で、山と渓流に囲まれた閑静な山間にある。
review_summary:
Guests mention this inn offers well-maintained, renovated rooms with abundant amenities and comfortable beds, along with delicious meals served in private dining rooms. They also highlight the genuine hot spring baths and the friendly, sincere staff who create a welcoming atmosphere.

Some reviews mention the hot springs can be cool.
sales_point_en: Located along the Otosawa River upstream of the Hōki River, this onsen is part of the Shiohara Onsen area, nestled in a quiet mountain valley surrounded by mountains and streams.

name: 川治温泉
location: 栃木県 日光市
sales_point: 鬼怒川と男鹿川の合流点に位置する温泉地。渓谷沿いで、閑静な環境。河畔の露天風呂が人気。
sales_point_en: Situated at the confluence of the Kinugawa and Oga Rivers, this onsen is located along a quiet valley. The riverside outdoor baths are particularly popular.

name: 川俣温泉
location: 栃木県 日光市
sales_point: 鬼怒川上流の渓谷沿いに位置する温泉地。標高1000メートルの高地にある山の湯。深い渓谷沿いに点在する露天風呂が人気を集めている。
sales_point_en: This onsen is located along a valley upstream of the Kinugawa River at an elevation of 1000 meters. It is known for its outdoor baths scattered along the deep valley.

name: 川俣湖温泉
location: 栃木県 日光市
sales_point: 鬼怒川上流の川俣湖を見下ろす位置にある温泉地。湖では川魚が釣れ、アウトドアスポーツ等が楽しめる。
sales_point_en: Overlooking Kawamata Lake upstream of the Kinugawa River, this onsen offers opportunities for fishing river fish and enjoying outdoor sports.

name: 北（那須高原温泉郷）
location: 栃木県 那須郡那須町
sales_point: 那須高原温泉郷一角で、余笹川の上流沿いに位置する温泉地。元禄時代からの湯治場。静かな山あいの秘湯。
sales_point_en: Located along the upper reaches of the Yosasagawa River in the Nasukogen Onsen area, this onsen has been a healing spot since the Genroku era. It is a quiet hidden hot spring in the mountains.

name: 喜連川温泉
location: 栃木県 さくら市
sales_point: 足利氏の城下町、奥州街道の宿場町として栄えた喜連川町に位置する温泉地。荒川の北岸にあり、保養・療養に好適。町営の温泉施設がある。
sales_point_en: Situated in Kizugawa Town, which prospered as a post town on the Oshu Highway near the castle town of the Ashikaga clan. Located on the north bank of the Arakawa River, it is suitable for recuperation and relaxation, with a municipal onsen facility available.

name: 鬼怒川温泉
location: 栃木県 日光市
sales_point: 鬼怒川の渓谷沿いに位置する温泉地。日本有数の大温泉地で、ライン下りや数々のテーマパークがあり、見所が豊富。
sales_point_en: Located along the Kinugawa River valley, this onsen is one of Japan's largest hot spring areas, featuring riverboat rides and numerous theme parks, offering plenty of attractions.

name: 黒磯温泉
location: 栃木県 那須塩原市
sales_point: 黒磯市街を抜けた那珂川沿いに位置する温泉地。黒磯市内観光の拠点に好適。
review_summary: Guests mention this inn offers delicious and hearty meals, including fresh river fish and homemade tofu, along with excellent hot spring baths. They also highlight the attentive and kind staff, who provide exceptional hospitality and thoughtful amenities like welcome matcha and post-bath ice cream. Visitors appreciate the calm, traditional Japanese atmosphere and the well-maintained, clean rooms.
sales_point_en: This onsen is located along the Naka River, just outside Kuroiso City. It serves as a convenient base for sightseeing in Kuroiso City.

name: 黒羽温泉
location: 栃木県 大田原市
sales_point: 那賀川の支流、余笹川河畔に位置する温泉地。那須の山々を遠望でき、余笹川を見下ろしながら入浴を楽しめる露天岩風呂がある。
review_summary: Visitors say this onsen features a wide and clean indoor bath, a deep open-air bath, and a sauna, with a highly alkaline water quality that leaves skin smooth. They also highlight the affordable 500 yen admission fee and the delicious, reasonably priced food available at the restaurant. Guests mention the staff are friendly and helpful, and the facility offers ample parking.
sales_point_en: Situated along the Yosasagawa River, a tributary of the Naka River, this onsen offers views of the Nasu mountains and features outdoor rock baths where you can enjoy bathing while overlooking the river.

name: 鶏頂温泉
location: 栃木県 日光市
sales_point: 日塩もみじラインの鶏頂高原に位置する温泉地。ゴルフ場の中にあり、通年、日帰りの入浴も可能。
sales_point_en: Located in the Chikucho Highlands along the Nikko Momiji Line, this onsen is situated within a golf course and offers year-round day-use bathing.

name: 小滝温泉
location: 栃木県 矢板市
sales_point: 高原山の東南側山麓、湯沢川の谷あいに位置する温泉地。渓谷は新緑、紅葉が特に美しい。
review_summary: Guests mention this hot spring inn offers clean, well-maintained rooms and a mineral spring bath that warms the body and leaves skin smooth. They also highlight the delicious, homemade meals, especially the juicy gyoza and delicate, flavorful dishes. Visitors appreciate the warm hospitality from the staff and the quiet, relaxing atmosphere.
sales_point_en: Nestled in the valley of the Yuzawa River on the southeastern foothills of the Kōgen Mountains, this onsen is particularly beautiful during the fresh green and autumn foliage seasons.

name: 三斗小屋（那須高原温泉郷）
location: 栃木県 那須塩原市
sales_point: 朝日岳の西側中腹、標高1450メートルに位置する温泉地。山道を最低２時間は歩かなくてはならない山の秘湯。
review_summary: People say this mountain inn offers a wonderful open-air bath with stunning mountain views and three different hot spring sources. Guests also highlight the delicious meals, which feel more like a traditional inn than a mountain hut, and the comfortable private rooms. They also appreciate the reasonable prices for drinks and the friendly, warm staff.
sales_point_en: Located on the western slope of Asahidake at an elevation of 1450 meters, this onsen is a hidden hot spring in the mountains that requires at least a two-hour hike to reach.

name: 塩釜（塩原温泉郷）
location: 栃木県 那須塩原市
sales_point: 岩塩が採掘され、釜で塩の精製が行われていたことが名の由来。塩原温泉郷の中で有数の湧出量を誇る。渓谷美の小太郎ヶ淵が近い。
sales_point_en: Named after the salt that was mined and refined in a kettle, this onsen boasts one of the highest flow rates in the Shiohara Onsen area. It is close to the scenic beauty of Kotaro's Abyss.

name: 塩の湯（塩原温泉郷）
location: 栃木県 那須塩原市
sales_point: 箒川の支流の鹿股川沿いの谷間に位置する温泉地。塩原温泉郷の一角で、山深く静かな環境にある。川岸の露天風呂は渓谷美を堪能できる。
review_summary: People say this hotel offers clean rooms with private open-air baths, providing a relaxing experience with the sound of the river. Guests also highlight the wide variety of complimentary services, including snacks, drinks, and late-night ramen. They appreciate the attentive and friendly staff, who contribute to a comfortable and enjoyable stay.
sales_point_en: Located in a valley along the Shikamata River, a tributary of the Hōki River, this onsen is part of the Shiohara Onsen area and is situated in a deep mountain environment. The riverside outdoor baths allow you to enjoy the beauty of the valley.

name: 塩谷温泉
location: 栃木県 塩谷郡塩谷町
sales_point: 関東平野を一望できる標高1796メートルの高原山の両翼に位置する温泉地。鬼怒川と荒川の清流にはさまれ、のどかな田園風景が広がる。閑静な環境にあり、保養・休養に好適。
review_summary:
Visitors say this onsen offers a relaxing open-air bath experience with views of the river and surrounding nature, and the water leaves skin feeling smooth. They also highlight the reasonable 800 yen admission fee and the friendly staff.

Some reviews mention the water temperature can be inconsistent.
sales_point_en: This onsen is located on the wings of a highland mountain at an elevation of 1796 meters, offering a panoramic view of the Kanto Plain. Nestled between the clear streams of the Kinugawa and Arakawa rivers, it features a tranquil rural landscape, making it ideal for recuperation and relaxation.

name: 新那須（那須高原温泉郷）
location: 栃木県 那須郡那須町
sales_point: 那須高原温泉郷の玄関口にあたる。大正時代から開発が進められた那須高原温泉郷の中では新しい温泉地。
sales_point_en: This onsen serves as the gateway to the Nasukogen Onsen area, which has been developed since the Taisho era, making it one of the newer hot springs in the region.

name: 高雄（那須高原温泉郷）
location: 栃木県 那須郡那須町
sales_point: 高雄股川沿いに位置する温泉地。湯貝と呼ばれる巻き貝が生息するめずらしい湯が特徴。那須岳や眼下の眺望が良い。
review_summary:
People say this lodge offers a wide variety of facilities, including a spacious and clean bathhouse, a mixed-gender open-air hot spring pool with stunning views, and free access to ping-pong and billiards. Guests also highlight the excellent value for money and the friendly, helpful staff.

Some reviews mention the indoor baths can be heavily chlorinated.
sales_point_en: Located along the Takao River, this onsen is characterized by its rare hot spring that is home to a type of spiral shell called 'yubai.' It offers great views of Mount Nasu and the scenery below.

name: 高根沢温泉
location: 栃木県 塩谷郡高根沢町
sales_point: 高根沢町の緑豊かな丘陵地帯に位置する温泉地。周囲を田園に囲まれ閑静な環境にあり、保養・静養に好適。
review_summary:
Guests consistently praise this hot spring facility for its spacious indoor and outdoor baths, including a wide open-air bath and a sauna. The clean facilities and attentive staff are also frequently highlighted by visitors.

Other reviews mention the admission fee for non-residents can be expensive.
sales_point_en: Situated in the lush hilly area of Takanesawa Town, this onsen is surrounded by farmland and offers a quiet environment, making it ideal for recuperation and relaxation.

name: 手白沢（奥鬼怒温泉郷）
location: 栃木県 日光市
sales_point: 奥鬼怒温泉郷のひとつ。鬼怒川源流のひとつの手白沢沿いに位置する温泉地。原生林に囲まれた山あいの秘湯。
review_summary: People say this hot spring inn offers exquisite cuisine, including fresh local river fish and seasonal vegetables, and features spacious, clean indoor and outdoor baths available 24 hours. They also highlight the warm hospitality from the staff and the cozy, modern wooden lodge with amenities like floor heating. Guests mention the reasonable prices for the quality of the experience.
sales_point_en: One of the Oku-Kinugawa Onsen, located along the Teshirasawa river, a hidden hot spring surrounded by primeval forests in the mountains.

name: 寺山温泉
location: 栃木県 矢板市
sales_point: 高原山の東南側山麓に位置する温泉地。温泉は近くの寺山観音寺の霊泉として開かれたと伝えられる。閑静な環境にあり、保養・療養に好適。
review_summary: People say this onsen ryokan offers private baths with iron-rich, reddish-brown water that leaves skin feeling smooth, and guests can adjust the water temperature to their liking. They also highlight the reasonable prices for day use and overnight stays, and the delicious homemade Japanese meals. Visitors appreciate the friendly and attentive staff, and the clean, well-maintained rooms and facilities.
sales_point_en: A hot spring located at the southeastern foot of Mount Takahara, believed to have been opened as a sacred spring of Terayama Kannon Temple. It offers a tranquil environment, ideal for relaxation and recuperation.

name: 那賀川温泉
location: 栃木県 那須郡那珂川町
sales_point: 那賀川沿いに位置する温泉地。川では6/1～9月末まで鮎釣りが楽しめる。湯はつるつるとして美人の湯と言われる。
sales_point_en: A hot spring located along the Nakagawa river, where you can enjoy sweetfish fishing from June 1st to the end of September. The water is smooth and is known as a beauty spring.

name: 中塩原（塩原温泉郷）
location: 栃木県 那須塩原市
sales_point: 日塩もみじラインと国道の分岐点付近に位置する温泉地。塩原温泉郷の一角。天然記念物「逆杉」がある八幡神社が近い。
review_summary:
People say this communal bath offers a strong, milky white sulfur spring with a distinct aroma, and the hot spring source is notably close to the building. Guests mention the affordable 300 yen entry fee and the availability of convenient parking.

Some reviews mention the bathroom can be small.
sales_point_en: A hot spring located near the junction of the Nikko-Shio Line and the national highway, part of the Shiohara Onsen area. Close to Hachiman Shrine, which features the natural monument 'Sakazuki Cedar.'

name: 那須湯本（那須高原温泉郷）
location: 栃木県 那須郡那須町
sales_point: 那須高原温泉郷の中心となる温泉地。那須で最も古い歴史をもつ温泉で、共同浴場の「鹿の湯」では独特の入浴法がある。
sales_point_en: The central hot spring of the Nasu Kogen Onsen area, known for its long history. The communal bath 'Shika no Yu' offers a unique bathing method.

name: 西那須野温泉
location: 栃木県 那須塩原市
sales_point: ＪＲ西那須野駅の東方、田園地帯の中に位置する温泉地。湯は無色透明で肌につやとうるおいを与える美人湯として知られ、近郊の人々の保養の場として賑わっている。
review_summary: People say this onsen offers excellent quality hot spring water, with a distinctive sulfurous scent and a unique color that changes with the light. They also highlight the deep outdoor bath, which is about one meter deep, and the well-maintained, compact facilities. Guests mention the reasonable 1,000 yen admission fee and the friendly staff.
sales_point_en: Located east of JR Nishi-Nasuno Station in a rural area, this hot spring features colorless and transparent water known for giving skin a glow and moisture, popular among locals for relaxation.

name: 日光温泉
location: 栃木県 日光市
sales_point: 日光の玄関口、東照宮・輪王寺・二荒山神社の門前町に位置する温泉地。ミニ散策路もあり、歴史・文化・自然を満喫できる。
review_summary: Guests mention this ryokan offers delicious and voluminous meals, including local specialties like yuba and freshly cooked rice, and features spacious, clean, and comfortable rooms. They also highlight the relaxing onsen, with some enjoying private or open-air baths. Visitors appreciate the exceptionally kind, caring, and helpful staff, as well as the excellent location within walking distance of major attractions.
sales_point_en: Located at the gateway to Nikko, near the Toshogu Shrine, Rinnoji Temple, and Futarasan Shrine. It features a mini walking path, allowing visitors to enjoy history, culture, and nature.

name: 日光光徳温泉
location: 栃木県 日光市
sales_point: 奥日光の男体山の裾野に位置する高原色豊かな温泉地。光徳牧場・戦場ヶ原・竜頭ノ滝などのハイキングの発着点に最適。
review_summary:
Guests mention this hotel offers excellent quality sulfur hot springs, with both indoor and open-air baths, and delicious meals featuring local seasonal ingredients like fried yamame trout. They also highlight the reasonable prices, the tranquil natural surroundings, and the attentive staff.

Some reviews mention the rooms can be dated.
sales_point_en: A vibrant hot spring area located at the foot of Mount Nantai in Oku-Nikko, ideal as a starting point for hiking to Koutoku Farm, Senjogahara, and Ryuzu Falls.

name: 日光沢（奥鬼怒温泉郷）
location: 栃木県 日光市
sales_point: 奥鬼怒温泉郷最奥の温泉地。奥鬼怒湿原の南東2.5キロ程に位置する秘湯。登山者の利用が多い。
review_summary: People say this hot spring offers two types of natural spring water: a milky, sulfurous bath and a clear sodium chloride bath, both of which are very relaxing. They also highlight the delicious, vegetable-focused meals, especially the glowing rice, and the friendly, helpful staff.
sales_point_en: The innermost hot spring of Oku-Kinugawa Onsen, located about 2.5 kilometers southeast of Oku-Kinugawa Marsh, popular among climbers.

name: 日光中禅寺温泉
location: 栃木県 日光市
sales_point: 奥日光の入口、中禅寺湖の東岸に位置する温泉地。付近には日本三名瀑のひとつ、華厳ノ滝等の観光名所が沢山ある。
review_summary: People say this hotel offers stunning views of Lake Chuzenji and the Torii gate from its rooms and dining areas. Guests also highlight the delicious and beautifully presented Japanese cuisine for both dinner and breakfast, with staff accommodating dietary restrictions. They also mention the attentive and professional staff, as well as the clean facilities and relaxing onsen baths.
sales_point_en: A hot spring located at the entrance of Oku-Nikko, on the eastern shore of Lake Chuzenji, surrounded by many tourist attractions, including one of Japan's three famous waterfalls, Kegon Falls.

name: 畑下（塩原温泉郷）
location: 栃木県 那須塩原市
sales_point: 塩原温泉郷の中程に位置する温泉地。箒川が湾曲した部分にあり、国道から奥まって静かな環境。尾崎紅葉の「金色夜叉」ゆかりの温泉として知られる。代表的な露天風呂のひとつ、「青葉の湯」がある。
sales_point_en: Located in the middle of Shiohara Onsen, this hot spring is situated in a quiet environment along a bend in the Hōki River. Known for its connection to the literary work 'Kinjirō Yasha' by Ozaki Kōyō, it features one of the representative outdoor baths, 'Aoba no Yu.'

name: 八丁の湯(奥鬼怒温泉郷)
location: 栃木県 日光市
sales_point: 奥鬼怒温泉郷のひとつ。女夫渕から林道を入って最初の温泉地。山深い谷間にある秘湯。滝を見ながら入れる露天風呂は野趣満点。
review_summary: People say this onsen offers stunning open-air baths with waterfall views, and guests enjoy the delicious, hearty meals featuring local ingredients. They also highlight the friendly and attentive staff, who provide excellent service.
sales_point_en: One of the Oku-Kinugawa Onsen, this hot spring is the first one you encounter after entering the forest road from Meoto-buchi. A hidden hot spring in a deep valley, it features an outdoor bath where you can enjoy the view of a waterfall.

name: 八方が原温泉
location: 栃木県 矢板市
sales_point: 温泉付の貸別荘が整備されている。のんびりくつろぐことができる。
review_summary:
Visitors say this highland destination offers stunning 360-degree views and vibrant azalea blooms, with well-maintained hiking trails suitable for sneakers. They also highlight the convenient, spacious parking and clean restrooms.

Some reviews mention the roads can be narrow with sharp curves.
sales_point_en: This hot spring features rental cottages with hot springs, providing a relaxing environment.

name: 馬頭温泉
location: 栃木県 那須郡那珂川町
sales_point: 八溝県立自然公園内に位置する温泉地。眼下に那珂川、投句に那須連山を望む風光明媚な地にあり、美人の湯としても知られている。
review_summary: People say this hot spring features a wide indoor bath and an open-air bath, both offering stunning views of the Naka River and surrounding mountains. Visitors also highlight the smooth, alkaline spring water, which leaves skin feeling soft, and appreciate the reasonable admission fee. They also mention the staff are friendly and the facilities are kept clean.
sales_point_en: Located within the Yatsugatake Prefectural Natural Park, this hot spring offers scenic views of the Nakagawa river below and the Nasu mountain range, known as a beauty spring.

name: 日向温泉
location: 栃木県 日光市
sales_point: 八汐湖畔に位置する温泉地。鬼怒川・川治観光の拠点にも好適。
sales_point_en: A hot spring located by the shores of Lake Hashio, making it a suitable base for exploring the Kinugawa and Kawaji areas.

name: 福渡（塩原温泉郷）
location: 栃木県 那須塩原市
sales_point: 塩原温泉郷の一角。箒川の渓流沿いに位置する温泉地。風光明媚な地にあり、明治以降、多くの文人に愛されてきた。高さ100メートルの天狗岩や七ッ岩、野立岩などの自然景観が良い。
sales_point_en: Part of the Shiohara Onsen area, this hot spring is located along the scenic Hōki River. It has been loved by many literary figures since the Meiji era, featuring beautiful natural landscapes such as the 100-meter-high Tengu Rock and Nanatsu Rock.

name: 古町（塩原温泉郷）
location: 栃木県 那須塩原市
sales_point: 塩原温泉郷の中心となる温泉地。旅館や土産物屋で賑わう。温泉街を走る観光馬車「トテ馬車」が風物詩。鍾乳洞「源三窟」などの見所が近い。
sales_point_en: The central hot spring of the Shiohara Onsen area, bustling with ryokans and souvenir shops. The 'Tote Basha' sightseeing horse-drawn carriage is a local attraction, with nearby attractions like the limestone cave 'Genzankutsu.'

name: 平家平温泉
location: 栃木県 日光市
sales_point: 川俣と女夫渕の中間、鬼怒川渓谷沿いに位置する温泉地。木をくり抜いた丸太風呂が名物で自然を見ながら入浴できる。
sales_point_en: Located between Kawamata and Meoto-buchi along the Kinugawa gorge, this hot spring is famous for its log baths carved from trees, allowing for a natural bathing experience.

name: 弁天（那須高原温泉郷）
location: 栃木県 那須郡那須町
sales_point: 那須岳中腹の渓谷沿いに位置する温泉地。那須高原温泉郷のひとつ。弁天様のお告げにより名付けられたと伝えられる。
sales_point_en: Situated along a valley on the slopes of Mount Nasu, this hot spring is one of the Nasu Kogen Onsen, named after a divine message from Benten.

name: 益子温泉
location: 栃木県 芳賀郡益子町
sales_point: 陶芸の里として有名な益子に位置する温泉地。丘陵地にあり、山並みを見渡すのどかな環境にある。
review_summary:
Guests mention this hotel offers delicious, high-quality Japanese kaiseki-style meals with many dishes, and features a unique "nereru sauna" where you can lie down. They also highlight the beautiful artificial waterfall in the open-air bath and the attentive staff.

Other reviews mention the artificial waterfall can be unreliable.
sales_point_en: Located in Mashiko, famous for pottery, this hot spring is set in a hilly area with a serene environment overlooking the mountain ranges.

name: 南那須温泉
location: 栃木県 那須烏山市
sales_point: 南那須町に点在する温泉施設の総称。各温泉施設とも日帰り入浴が可能。ＪＲ大金駅から近く旅行の疲れをいやすには好適。
review_summary:
People say this onsen features spacious indoor baths and open-air rotenburo with views of a well-maintained lawn and forest, along with a Finnish sauna. They also highlight the clean facilities, ample parking, and reasonable prices, especially for evening entry.

Some reviews mention the water pressure can be weak.
sales_point_en: A collective term for the hot spring facilities scattered throughout Minami Nasushi Town. Each facility offers day-use bathing, making it a great place to relax after a trip, conveniently located near JR Okagane Station.

name: 三依温泉
location: 栃木県 日光市
sales_point: 男鹿川の上流に位置する温泉地。渓谷美を堪能できる山あいのいで湯。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located upstream of the Oga River, offering beautiful valley scenery in a mountainous setting.

name: 女夫渕温泉
location: 栃木県 日光市
sales_point: 奥鬼怒温泉郷の入口にある温泉地。川沿いに12もの露天風呂があることで有名。湯量も豊富。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area at the entrance of the Oku-Kinugawa Onsen region, famous for its 12 outdoor baths along the river, with abundant hot spring water.

name: 元湯（塩原温泉郷）
location: 栃木県 那須塩原市
sales_point: 箒川の源流のひとつ、赤川河畔に位置する温泉地。塩原温泉発祥の地にあり、温泉郷の最奥。秘湯の趣が人気を集めている。
review_summary:
Guests mention this hot spring inn offers three distinct, high-quality sulfur hot springs, including open-air baths with scenic views, and delicious, healthy meals. They also highlight the friendly staff, the opportunity to interact with rescued cats, and the overall relaxing atmosphere.

Some reviews mention the facility can be neglected.
sales_point_en: Located by the banks of the Akagawa River, one of the sources of the Hōki River. It is the birthplace of Shiobara Onsen and the innermost part of the hot spring area, popular for its hidden hot spring charm.

name: 門前（塩原温泉郷）
location: 栃木県 那須塩原市
sales_point: 塩原温泉郷の中心となる温泉地。門前町として栄えたのが名の由来。旅館や土産物店などが軒を連ねて活気がある。
sales_point_en: The central hot spring area of Shiobara Onsen, named after the prosperous Monzen Town. It is lively with many inns and souvenir shops.

name: 矢板温泉
location: 栃木県 矢板市
sales_point: 矢板市郊外の山間に位置する温泉地。
review_summary:
People say this onsen offers a spacious outdoor bath and hot indoor baths, with some also featuring a refreshing cold plunge pool. Guests mention the affordable entry fees, the delicious food at the dining area, and the option for cashless payments.

Other reviews mention the shower pressure can be weak.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located in the mountains on the outskirts of Yaita City.

name: 八幡（那須高原温泉郷）
location: 栃木県 那須郡那須町
sales_point: 那須岳中腹、標高1100メートルに位置する温泉地。眺望は那須高原温泉郷随一と言われている。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located at an elevation of 1,100 meters on the slopes of Mount Nasu, reputed to have the best views in the Nasukogen Onsen region.

name: 油井温泉
location: 栃木県 那須塩原市
sales_point: 那珂川の渓流沿いに位置する温泉地。豊かな自然に恵まれ、保養・休養に好適。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located along the Nakagawa River, blessed with rich nature, ideal for relaxation and recuperation.

name: 湯津上温泉
location: 栃木県 大田原市
sales_point: 那珂川、箒川、蛇尾川の清流に囲まれた湯津上村に位置する温泉地。見晴らしの良い丘の上にあり、眺望が良い。近郷の人々の利用も多い。
sales_point_en: Situated in Yuzukami Village, surrounded by the clear streams of the Nakagawa, Hōki, and Jōbi Rivers. Located on a hill with great views, it is popular among local residents.

name: 湯西川温泉
location: 栃木県 日光市
sales_point: 湯西川の源流近くに位置する温泉地。平家の落人が隠れ住んだという伝説が残されている。山里にあり、自然環境に恵まれている。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located near the source of the Yunishigawa River, with legends of the Heike clan's fugitives hiding here. Nestled in the mountains, it is blessed with a beautiful natural environment.

name: ろまんちっく温泉
location: 栃木県 宇都宮市
sales_point: 宇都宮市街の北西部に位置する温泉地。ろまんちっく村の中にあり、日光方面の観光拠点に好適。
review_summary:
People say this onsen offers spacious indoor and outdoor baths, with the outdoor bath providing a relaxing atmosphere and pleasant views. They also highlight the affordable prices, clean facilities, and comfortable rest areas with free drinks and Wi-Fi.

Other reviews mention there can be a strong chlorine smell in the baths.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located in the northwest part of Utsunomiya City, within the Romantic Village, making it a great base for sightseeing in the Nikko area.

name: 芦ノ湖（箱根温泉郷）
location: 神奈川県 足柄下郡箱根町
sales_point: 芦ノ湖畔元箱根に位置する温泉地。箱根温泉郷の一角で、箱根神社の門前町として発展した。遊覧船の発着場も近く、芦ノ湖畔の中心的場所として賑わう。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located at Moto-Hakone on the shores of Lake Ashi. It developed as a post town for Hakone Shrine and is bustling as a central location for sightseeing, with a ferry terminal nearby.

name: 芦之湯（箱根温泉郷）
location: 神奈川県 足柄下郡箱根町
sales_point: 駒ヶ岳、二子山に囲まれた山間に位置する温泉地。開湯は江戸初期と古く昔から文人墨客に親しまれてきた。箱根温泉郷の一角。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located in the mountains surrounded by Mount Komagatake and Futakoyama. It has been cherished by literary figures since its opening in the early Edo period, and is part of the Hakone Onsen region.

name: 阿部倉温泉
location: 神奈川県 横須賀市
sales_point: 三浦半島の中心部、大楠山の登山道入口近くに位置する温泉地。山頂からは伊豆半島や富士山の眺望が抜群で、絶好のハイキングコースとなっている。歴史ある古湯で、三浦一族の隠し湯とも伝えられている。
review_summary: People say this hot spring inn offers a unique artistic atmosphere and a hot spring with skin-smoothing qualities. They also highlight the delicious meals, especially the fresh tuna sashimi and tempura, and the attentive staff.
sales_point_en: Located near the entrance to the hiking trail of Mount Ōkusa in the center of the Miura Peninsula. The summit offers excellent views of the Izu Peninsula and Mount Fuji, making it a great hiking course. It is an ancient hot spring, said to be a hidden spring of the Miura clan.

name: 飯山温泉
location: 神奈川県 厚木市
spa_quality: 強アルカリ性単純温泉
sales_point: 本厚木駅の北西約6キロの白山麓に位置し、小鮎川沿いに湧き出る温泉地。周辺に飯山白山森林公園が広がり、静かな自然に恵まれている。
review_summary:
Guests mention this inn offers high-quality, strong alkaline hot springs known for making skin smooth, and delicious, voluminous meals featuring local seasonal ingredients like wild boar hot pot and ayu. They also highlight the attentive staff, private-feeling rooms, and convenient shuttle bus service from Hon-Atsugi Station.

Some reviews mention the rooms can be dated.
spa_quality_en: 強アルカリ性単純温泉
sales_point_en: Located about 6 kilometers northwest of Hon-Atsugi Station, this hot spring area springs forth along the Koyagawa River, surrounded by the Iiyama Hakusan Forest Park, offering a tranquil natural environment.

name: 伊勢原温泉
location: 神奈川県 伊勢原市
sales_point: 伊勢原市の山あいに位置する温泉地。約6キロ西方には大山ケーブルがあり、浅間山登山基地に好適。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located in the mountains of Isehara City, with the Ōyama Cable Car about 6 kilometers to the west, making it a suitable base for climbing Mount Asama.

name: 姥子（箱根温泉郷）
location: 神奈川県 足柄下郡箱根町
spa_quality: 単純温泉、炭酸水素塩泉、硫酸塩泉
sales_point: 大涌谷の西側、冠ヶ岳の山麓に位置する温泉地。箱根温泉郷のひとつに数えられ、閑静な環境にある。坂田金時の姥が探した湯で眼病が治ったという伝説が残る。
review_summary:
Visitors say this ropeway station offers a peaceful retreat into nature with clear signage, and it's a convenient, less crowded option for accessing the Hakone Ropeway. They also highlight the free and ample parking, making it ideal for avoiding congestion at other stations.

Some reviews mention the ropeway can be expensive.
spa_quality_en: Simple Spring, Bicarbonate Spring, Sulfate Spring
sales_point_en: Located on the western side of Ōwakudani, at the foot of Mount Kanmuri. It is one of the Hakone Onsen areas, situated in a quiet environment. There is a legend that the bath found by the old woman of Sakata Kintoki cured eye diseases.

name: 大楠温泉
location: 神奈川県 横須賀市
sales_point: 大楠山山麓の源泉を相模湾側の秋谷海岸まで引湯している温泉。海水浴、釣り、マリンスポーツ客で賑わう秋谷海岸から徒歩2～3分の所だが、辺りは木々に囲まれており、閑静な環境。湯は効能が高い。
review_summary:
People say this onsen offers an open-air bath with stunning ocean views of Tokyo Bay, along with a variety of indoor baths and saunas. They also highlight the delicious food, clean facilities, and convenient, spacious parking.

Some reviews mention the baths can be overcrowded.
sales_point_en: A hot spring that draws water from the source at the foot of Mount Ōkusa to the coast of Akiya in Sagami Bay. It is just a 2-3 minute walk from the bustling Akiya coast, popular for swimming, fishing, and marine sports, yet surrounded by trees, providing a tranquil environment. The water is known for its high efficacy.

name: 大平台（箱根温泉郷）
location: 神奈川県 足柄下郡箱根町
spa_quality: 塩化物泉、アルカリ性単純温泉
sales_point: 登山鉄道がスイッチバックを繰り返す標高350メートルの台地に位置する温泉地。箱根温泉郷の一角で、保養向きの宿が多い。
spa_quality_en: Chloride Spring, アルカリ性単純温泉
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located on a plateau at an elevation of 350 meters, where the mountain railway repeatedly performs switchbacks. It is part of the Hakone Onsen region, with many accommodations suitable for recuperation.

name: かぶと湯温泉
location: 神奈川県 厚木市
spa_quality: その他(メタけい酸およびメタほう酸の項で該当)
sales_point: 東丹沢の山あい、玉川の上流に位置する温泉地。関東大震災でかぶと岩が崩れて自然湧出した。アルカリ度が大変強く、美肌効果が高い。飲用可。
review_summary: People say this hot spring inn offers exquisite, soft, and smooth alkaline spring water that leaves skin feeling moisturized. They also highlight the calm, retro atmosphere and the delicious, carefully prepared meals. Guests mention the staff are kind and attentive, providing a welcoming and intimate experience.
spa_quality_en: その他(メタけい酸およびメタほう酸の項で該当)
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located in the mountains of Higashi Tanzawa, upstream of the Tamagawa River. It emerged naturally when Kabuto Rock collapsed during the Great Kanto Earthquake. The water has a very high alkalinity, known for its skin beautifying effects, and is also drinkable.

name: 川崎中原温泉
location: 神奈川県 川崎中原区
spa_quality: ナトリウム－炭酸水素塩泉、塩化物泉
sales_point: 向河原駅からすぐというアクセスの便利な温泉地。ビジネス・観光の拠点として好適。
review_summary:
People say this onsen offers a unique, rustic atmosphere with a large indoor bath and a beautiful outdoor rock bath, featuring mineral-rich, amber-colored water that leaves skin smooth and warm. They also highlight the quiet, relaxing environment, the delicious food at the adjacent restaurant, and the convenient location near the station.

Some reviews mention the facilities can be poorly maintained.
spa_quality_en: ナトリウム－炭酸水素塩泉, Chloride Spring
sales_point_en: A conveniently accessible hot spring area just a short walk from Mukogawara Station, ideal for business and tourism.

name: 川崎宮前温泉
location: 神奈川県 川崎宮前区
sales_point: 緑豊かな自然に包まれ、閑静な住宅地と植木の里が調和した恵まれたロケーションの中にある温泉地。源泉がある影向寺等、数々の古刹が残され、古寺巡りを兼ねたハイキングコースがある。
review_summary: Visitors say this hot spring facility offers a wide variety of baths, including a unique black-colored natural hot spring and carbonated amber baths, which leave skin feeling smooth. They also highlight the clean and relaxing atmosphere, with many enjoying the spacious rock saunas and comfortable reclining chairs. Guests mention the delicious and high-quality food available at the restaurant, making it a great place to spend a full day.
sales_point_en: Nestled in a lush natural setting, this hot spring area harmonizes with a quiet residential neighborhood and a garden village. It features several ancient temples, including Kageyō-ji, and offers hiking trails that combine temple visits.

name: 木賀（箱根温泉郷）
location: 神奈川県 足柄下郡箱根町
spa_quality: 塩化物泉、アルカリ性単純温泉
sales_point: 箱根温泉郷の一角。早川を眼下に望む静かな環境にある温泉地。木賀渓谷と紅葉が美しい。
spa_quality_en: Chloride Spring, アルカリ性単純温泉
sales_point_en: Located in a quiet environment overlooking the Hayakawa River, this hot spring area is part of the Hakone Onsen region, known for its beautiful Kiga Valley and autumn foliage.

name: 衣笠温泉
location: 神奈川県 横須賀市
spa_quality: アルカリ性単純硫黄冷鉱泉
sales_point: 衣笠ICからすぐという車の便が良い温泉地。新鮮な山の幸、海の幸を満喫できる。三浦半島観光の足場として好適。
spa_quality_en: アルカリ性単純硫黄冷鉱泉
sales_point_en: A hot spring area with excellent access from Kinugasa IC, offering fresh mountain and sea delicacies. It serves as a great base for sightseeing in the Miura Peninsula.

name: 広沢寺温泉
location: 神奈川県 厚木市
spa_quality: 強アルカリ性単純温泉
sales_point: 玉川の上流、大沢川沿いに位置する温泉地。寺院風の落ち着いた一軒宿では、イノシシ鍋が人気。
spa_quality_en: 強アルカリ性単純温泉
sales_point_en: Situated along the upper reaches of the Tamagawa River, this hot spring area features a tranquil temple-style inn known for its popular wild boar hot pot.

name: 小涌谷（箱根温泉郷）
location: 神奈川県 足柄下郡箱根町
spa_quality: アルカリ性単純温泉、塩化物泉
sales_point: 箱根温泉郷の一角。蓬莱山の斜面、標高500メートルに位置する温泉地。桜とツツジが美しく咲き、辺りの眺望が良い。
spa_quality_en: アルカリ性単純温泉, Chloride Spring
sales_point_en: Located on the slopes of Mount Horai at an elevation of 500 meters, this hot spring area is part of the Hakone Onsen region, known for its beautiful cherry blossoms and azaleas, as well as great views.

name: 強羅（箱根温泉郷）
location: 神奈川県 足柄下郡箱根町
spa_quality: 硫酸塩泉、アルカリ性単純温泉、塩化物泉
sales_point: 早雲山の東斜面、標高600メートルの高地に位置する温泉地。昔ながらの温泉保養地で、箱根温泉郷の一角。目前に外輪山の雄大な眺望が広がる。
spa_quality_en: Sulfate Spring, アルカリ性単純温泉, Chloride Spring
sales_point_en: Situated at an elevation of 600 meters on the eastern slope of Sōunzan, this traditional hot spring area offers magnificent views of the outer rim mountains and is part of the Hakone Onsen region.

name: 仙石原（箱根温泉郷）
location: 神奈川県 足柄下郡箱根町
sales_point: 箱根温泉郷の最奥、仙石原の高原に位置する温泉地。下湯･上湯･元湯･俵石･仙石の地区に分かれ、これらを総称して仙石原温泉と呼ぶ。
review_summary: Guests mention this ryokan offers spacious, clean rooms, private onsens with milky, volcanic water, and delicious kaiseki dinners and breakfasts featuring seasonal ingredients. They also highlight the well-maintained gardens and the serene, quiet atmosphere. Visitors appreciate the attentive, professional staff who provide exceptional service and hospitality, often going above and beyond to assist guests.
sales_point_en: Located in the highlands of Sengokuhara, the innermost part of the Hakone Onsen region, this hot spring area is divided into several districts, including Shitayu, Uetayu, Motoyu, Tawaraishi, and Sengokuhara.

name: 底倉（箱根温泉郷）
location: 神奈川県 足柄下郡箱根町
sales_point: 箱根温泉郷のひとつに数えられる温泉地。「箱根彫刻の森美術館」の南側ほど近くに位置する。室町時代から湧いていたと伝えられる古湯。
sales_point_en: Considered one of the hot springs in the Hakone Onsen region, it is located near the southern side of the Hakone Open-Air Museum and is said to have been flowing since the Muromachi period.

name: 蛸川（箱根温泉郷）
location: 神奈川県 足柄下郡箱根町
sales_point: 芦ノ湖東岸、駒ヶ岳の麓に広がる温泉地。箱根温泉郷の一角で、元箱根・芦ノ湖観光の拠点に好適。
sales_point_en: This hot spring area spreads out at the foot of Mount Komagatake on the eastern shore of Lake Ashi, making it an ideal base for sightseeing in Motohakone and Lake Ashi.

name: 鶴巻温泉
location: 神奈川県 秦野市
sales_point: 都心から約1時間。小田急線沿いに位置する温泉地。便利ながら自然環境に恵まれている。カルシウム含有量が世界一とも言われる泉質が大きな特徴。
sales_point_en: Located about an hour from the city center along the Odakyu Line, this hot spring area is convenient yet blessed with a natural environment. It is known for its mineral-rich waters, said to have the highest calcium content in the world.

name: 塔之沢（箱根温泉郷）
location: 神奈川県 足柄下郡箱根町
sales_point: 早川の渓流、国道1号線沿いに位置する温泉地。箱根温泉郷の一角で、落ち着いた木造の宿が多い。江戸時代からの古湯。
sales_point_en: Positioned along the Hayakawa River and National Route 1, this hot spring area features many tranquil wooden inns and is known for its ancient hot springs dating back to the Edo period.

name: 堂ヶ島（箱根温泉郷）
location: 神奈川県 足柄下郡箱根町
sales_point: 早川の渓谷に面している温泉地。宮ノ下温泉から自家用のケーブルカー、ロープウェイで降りていく。箱根温泉郷のひとつに数えられる。
sales_point_en: Facing the Hayakawa Valley, this hot spring area can be accessed via a private cable car and ropeway from Miyanoshita Onsen. It is considered one of the hot springs in the Hakone Onsen region.

name: 中川温泉
location: 神奈川県 足柄上郡山北町
sales_point: 丹沢湖の更に奥、河内川上流沿いに位置する温泉地。信玄の隠し湯と言われる。飲用すると胃腸に効くという。渓流釣りも楽しめ、西丹沢登山基地にも最適。
review_summary:
People say this hot spring offers a relaxing experience with smooth, alkaline water in both indoor and outdoor baths, and features a spacious tatami-mat resting area. Visitors also highlight the affordable entry fees and the convenient option to combine a visit with river activities.

Some reviews mention the baths can be crowded.
sales_point_en: Located further upstream along the Kawachi River, this hot spring area is said to be a hidden hot spring of Shingen. It is believed to be beneficial for the stomach when consumed and offers opportunities for stream fishing, making it ideal for climbing in the West Tanzawa area.

name: 中里温泉
location: 神奈川県 横浜市
sales_point: 横浜市南区の弘明寺公園そばの住宅街に位置する温泉旅館。
review_summary:
People say this public bath offers a variety of baths, including a spacious black hot spring, jet baths, and a cold black water bath, with a clean and well-maintained sauna. They also highlight the reasonable prices, free parking, and the option to enjoy food and drinks in the dining area.

Some reviews mention the facility can be crowded.
sales_point_en: A hot spring ryokan located in a residential area near Kōmyō-ji Park in Minami Ward, Yokohama.

name: 七沢温泉
location: 神奈川県 厚木市
sales_point: 大山の東側山麓、玉川上流に位置する温泉地。丹沢大山国定公園内にあり、閑静な環境。古くから美人の湯として名高く、湯治場として親しまれてきた。
review_summary:
