People say this onsen has an exceptional strong alkaline spring that leaves skin feeling smooth and moisturized, with many highlighting the unique sensation of the shower water. They also appreciate the clean facilities, delicious food, and the friendly, attentive staff.

Some reviews mention the bathing area can be crowded.
sales_point_en: Situated on the eastern foothills of Mount Ōyama, upstream of the Tamagawa River, this hot spring area is located within Tanzawa-Ōyama National Park, offering a quiet environment. It has long been known as a beautiful hot spring and is cherished as a place for healing.

name: 二ノ平（箱根温泉郷）
location: 神奈川県 足柄下郡箱根町
spa_quality: アルカリ性単純温泉、塩化物泉
sales_point: 「箱根彫刻の森美術館」の近くに位置する温泉地。近年開発された新しい温泉地で、箱根温泉郷のひとつに数えられる。
spa_quality_en: アルカリ性単純温泉, Chloride Spring
sales_point_en: Located near the Hakone Open-Air Museum, this hot spring area is a newly developed site and is considered one of the hot springs in the Hakone Onsen region.

name: 根府川温泉
location: 神奈川県 小田原市
sales_point: おだやかな相模湾を望む温泉地。運動・休養・栄養の３つの視点からリフレッシュする健康スポットになっている。
review_summary:
Guests mention this lodging offers private log cabins with open-air baths and delicious, hearty meals like pork confit and sashimi. They also highlight the peaceful, natural setting, perfect for stargazing, and the option to enjoy coffee and sweets on outdoor terraces.

Some reviews mention the dinner offerings can be insufficient.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area overlooking the calm Sagami Bay, it serves as a health spot for refreshing through exercise, relaxation, and nutrition.

name: 箱根湯本（箱根温泉郷）
location: 神奈川県 足柄下郡箱根町
spa_quality: アルカリ性単純温泉、塩化物泉、硫酸塩泉
sales_point: 箱根温泉郷の中心的存在となる温泉地。早川と須雲川の合流点付近に温泉街が開けている。日本屈指の温泉地。
spa_quality_en: アルカリ性単純温泉, Chloride Spring, Sulfate Spring
sales_point_en: A central hot spring area in the Hakone Onsen region, with a hot spring town developed near the confluence of the Hayakawa and Sugumo rivers, it is one of Japan's top hot spring destinations.

name: 別所温泉
location: 神奈川県 愛甲郡清川村
spa_quality: アルカリ性単純硫黄冷鉱泉
sales_point: 東丹沢の三峰山東側山麓に位置する温泉地。小鮎川の谷あいにあり、静かな環境にある。保養・休養に好適。丹沢登山やレジャースポットとして賑わいを見せている。
review_summary:
Visitors say this public bath offers a variety of baths, including a hot indoor bath, a sauna, and a relaxing outdoor bath with forest views. They also highlight the affordable entry fees, especially with JAF discounts, and the delicious food at the on-site restaurant.

Other reviews mention the facility can be poorly maintained.
spa_quality_en: アルカリ性単純硫黄冷鉱泉
sales_point_en: Located on the eastern foothills of Mount Sanmine in the Higashi Tanzawa area, this hot spring area is nestled in a quiet environment along the valley of the Koayu River, making it ideal for relaxation and recuperation. It is popular for hiking in Tanzawa and as a leisure spot.

name: 三浦マホロバ温泉
location: 神奈川県 三浦市
sales_point: 三浦海岸近くの高台に位置する温泉地。眺望が良い。
review_summary:
People say this hotel offers spacious, clean rooms with stunning ocean views and a wide variety of delicious buffet options, including fresh local tuna and made-to-order items. They also highlight the friendly and attentive staff, as well as the enjoyable indoor pool and natural hot spring.

Other reviews mention the rooms can be dated.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located on a high ground near Miura Beach, offering great views.

name: 宮城野（箱根温泉郷）
location: 神奈川県 足柄下郡箱根町
spa_quality: 硫黄泉、アルカリ性単純温泉
sales_point: 明神ヶ岳南側山麓に広がった高原の一角に位置する温泉地。箱根温泉郷のひとつで、静寂感漂う自然林の中でゆったりと露天風呂に入ることが出来る。
spa_quality_en: Sulfur Spring, アルカリ性単純温泉
sales_point_en: Situated in a highland area at the southern foot of Myojin Mountain, this hot spring is one of the Hakone Onsen areas, allowing visitors to relax in open-air baths surrounded by tranquil natural forests.

name: 宮ノ下（箱根温泉郷）
location: 神奈川県 足柄下郡箱根町
sales_point: 早川とその支流の蛇骨川の間に位置する温泉地。高台にあり展望が良好。箱根温泉郷の中でも昔から外国人観光客の利用が多い。
sales_point_en: Located between the Hayakawa River and its tributary, the Jakotsu River, this hot spring area is on a high ground with excellent views and has been popular with foreign tourists for many years.

name: 湯河原温泉
location: 神奈川県 足柄下郡湯河原町
sales_point: 神奈川県南西端に位置する温泉地。千歳川とその上流の藤木川を挟んで、約4キロにわたる温泉街を形成している。その昔万葉集にも詠まれた由緒ある温泉地で、「子宝の湯」としても知られる。
sales_point_en: Located at the southwestern tip of Kanagawa Prefecture, this hot spring area forms a 4-kilometer-long hot spring town between the Chitose River and the upstream Fujiki River. It is a historic hot spring mentioned in the Manyoshu and is also known as the 'hot spring of childbearing.'

name: 湯の花沢（箱根温泉郷）
location: 神奈川県 足柄下郡箱根町
sales_point: 駒ヶ岳の東側山麓、湯の花高原に位置する温泉地。箱根温泉郷で最も高所にあり、スポーツリゾート地でもある。
sales_point_en: Situated on the eastern foothills of Mount Komagatake, this hot spring area is the highest in the Hakone Onsen region and is also a sports resort.

name: 赤岩（みなかみ18湯）
location: 群馬県 利根郡みなかみ町
spa_quality: ナトリウム・カルシウム－硫酸塩泉
sales_point: 赤谷川沿いに位置する温泉地。閑静な環境で静養に好適。猿ヶ京三国温泉郷のひとつ。
spa_quality_en: ナトリウム・カルシウム－硫酸塩泉
sales_point_en: Located along the Akaya River, this hot spring area is ideal for relaxation in a quiet environment and is one of the Sarugakyo Mikuni Onsen areas.

name: 赤城温泉
location: 群馬県 前橋市
spa_quality: カルシウム・マグネシウム・ナトリウム－炭酸水素塩泉
sales_point: 赤城山の裾野標高950メートルの山あいに位置する温泉地。万病に効く上州の薬湯として知られており、古くから湯治場として親しまれている。
review_summary: Guests mention this inn offers delicious and thoughtfully prepared meals, including local Gunma ingredients and unique dishes like whole-fried char. They also highlight the spotless and well-maintained facilities, including the private hot spring baths. Visitors appreciate the attentive and friendly staff, who provide excellent service.
spa_quality_en: カルシウム・マグネシウム・ナトリウム－炭酸水素塩泉
sales_point_en: Nestled at an elevation of 950 meters on the foothills of Mount Akagi, this hot spring is known as a medicinal bath effective for various ailments and has been cherished as a healing spot for a long time.

name: 浅間高原温泉
location: 群馬県 吾妻郡長野原町
spa_quality: マグネシウム・ナトリウム－硫酸塩泉・塩化物泉・炭酸水素塩泉
sales_point: 浅間山の裾野に位置する温泉地。一帯は樹林に囲まれ自然環境が良い。軽井沢観光の拠点に好適。
spa_quality_en: マグネシウム・ナトリウム－硫酸塩泉・塩化物泉・炭酸水素塩泉
sales_point_en: Located at the foothills of Mount Asama, this hot spring area is surrounded by forests, providing a great natural environment and is suitable as a base for sightseeing in Karuizawa.

name: 伊香保温泉
location: 群馬県 渋川市
spa_quality: カルシウム・ナトリウム－硫酸塩泉、炭酸水素塩泉、塩化物泉
sales_point: 榛名山の中腹に位置する温泉地。子宝の湯として知られる。石段街があり独特の湯の町情趣が漂う。温泉は旧来の温泉（黄金り湯）と近年開発された白銀の湯の２種類。
spa_quality_en: カルシウム・ナトリウム－硫酸塩泉, Bicarbonate Spring, Chloride Spring
sales_point_en: Situated on the slopes of Mount Haruna, this hot spring is known as the 'hot spring of childbearing.' It features a stone stair street that exudes a unique hot spring town atmosphere, with two types of water: the traditional golden water and the recently developed silver water.

name: 磯部温泉
location: 群馬県 安中市
spa_quality: ナトリウム－塩化物泉・炭酸水素塩強塩冷鉱泉
sales_point: 碓氷川の南岸に位置する温泉地。天明３年、浅間山大噴火の際に湧出したのが始まり。自然環境に恵まれた閑静な環境にあり、新緑や紅葉が美しい。碓氷川の釣りも楽しめる。西上州観光の拠点に好適。
spa_quality_en: ナトリウム－塩化物泉・炭酸水素塩強塩冷鉱泉
sales_point_en: Located on the southern bank of the Usui River, this hot spring area began to emerge during the great eruption of Mount Asama in the third year of Tenmei. It is in a quiet environment blessed with nature, showcasing beautiful fresh greenery and autumn leaves, and is suitable as a base for sightseeing in the western Joshu area.

name: 猪田温泉
location: 群馬県 藤岡市
spa_quality: その他(メタほう酸・総硫黄の項で該当)
sales_point: 牛伏山の南側山麓に位置する温泉地。山あいの静かな環境にあり、保養・休養に好適。
spa_quality_en: その他(メタほう酸・総硫黄の項で該当)
sales_point_en: Located on the southern foothills of Mount Ushibuse, this hot spring area is in a quiet mountain environment, ideal for relaxation and recuperation.

name: 水上高原上の原（みなかみ18湯）
location: 群馬県 利根郡みなかみ町
spa_quality: ナトリウム－塩化物泉・炭酸水素塩泉
sales_point: 胴元湖に注ぐ湯ノ小屋沿いに位置する温泉地。水上温泉郷最奥にある。
review_summary:
People say this hotel offers direct access to the ski slopes, a wide variety of activities, and delicious buffet meals with diverse options. Guests also highlight the friendly and attentive staff, along with the relaxing outdoor hot springs.

Other reviews mention the buffet can be inconsistent.
spa_quality_en: ナトリウム－塩化物泉・炭酸水素塩泉
sales_point_en: This hot spring area is located along the Yuno Koya River, which flows into Lake Domoto, and is situated at the innermost part of the Minakami Onsen area.

name: うのせ（みなかみ18湯）
location: 群馬県 利根郡みなかみ町
sales_point: 利根川沿いに位置する温泉地。近年までは大穴温泉と称していた。水上温泉郷のひとつ。渓谷美が見事で、秋の紅葉は絶景。
review_summary: People say this onsen offers excellent quality hot spring water with a smooth, silky feel, and features both an indoor and an open-air bath. Visitors also highlight the affordable entry fee and the availability of free amenities like shampoo, body soap, and lockers. Guests mention the simple, rustic atmosphere and the friendly locals who frequent the facility.
sales_point_en: Located along the Tone River, this hot spring area was formerly known as Oana Onsen. It is one of the Minakami Onsen areas, featuring stunning valley scenery, especially beautiful during autumn foliage.

name: 老神温泉
location: 群馬県 沼田市
sales_point: 片品川の渓谷沿いに位置する温泉地。大小さまざまな旅館が渓谷際に建ち並ぶ。自然環境に恵まれ、景観が良い。
sales_point_en: Situated along the Katashina River valley, this hot spring area has various inns lined up along the valley. It is blessed with a beautiful natural environment and scenic views.

name: 応徳温泉
location: 群馬県 吾妻郡中之条町
spa_quality: ナトリウム・カルシウム－硫酸塩泉・塩化物泉
sales_point: 白砂渓谷沿いに位置する温泉地。静かな環境にあり保養・休養に好適。日帰りの入浴も可能。
review_summary:
People say this hot spring offers high-quality, sulfur-rich water that leaves the body warm and refreshed. Guests also highlight the affordable 500 yen entry fee and the friendly staff.

Some reviews mention there can be a lack of shampoo.
spa_quality_en: ナトリウム・カルシウム－硫酸塩泉・塩化物泉
sales_point_en: Located along the Shirasuna Valley, this hot spring area is in a quiet environment, ideal for relaxation and recuperation, with day-use bathing available.

name: 大胡温泉
location: 群馬県 前橋市
spa_quality: その他(メタけい酸の項で該当)
sales_point: 寺沢川上流の河畔に位置する温泉地。遠く北方に赤城山を望む。自然に恵まれた閑静な環境で、休養・保養に好適。
spa_quality_en: その他(メタけい酸の項で該当)
sales_point_en: This hot spring area is located along the riverbank upstream of the Terasawa River, offering views of Mount Akagi in the distance. It is in a quiet environment blessed with nature, suitable for relaxation and recuperation.

name: 大島鉱泉温泉
location: 群馬県 富岡市
spa_quality: その他(メタほう酸の項で該当)
sales_point: 鏑川の清流沿いに位置する温泉地。山あいの静かな環境にあり、保養・休養に好適。群馬サファリパークがすぐ近くにある。
review_summary:
People say this onsen offers excellent quality hot spring water that warms the body and leaves skin smooth, with amenities like shampoo and soap provided. They also highlight the nostalgic, retro atmosphere and the friendly, welcoming staff.

Some reviews mention the facilities can be bare minimum.
spa_quality_en: その他(メタほう酸の項で該当)
sales_point_en: Located along the clear stream of the Kaburagawa River, this hot spring area is in a quiet mountain environment, ideal for relaxation and recuperation, with Gunma Safari Park nearby.

name: 大塚温泉
location: 群馬県 吾妻郡中之条町
sales_point: 中之条駅の北東部の山あいに位置する温泉地。閑静な環境にあり、保養・療養に好適。
sales_point_en: Situated in the mountains northeast of Nakanojo Station, this hot spring area is in a quiet environment, ideal for relaxation and therapy.

name: 奥平（みなかみ18湯）
location: 群馬県 利根郡みなかみ町
sales_point: 川手山森林公園の中に位置する温泉地。自然環境に恵まれている。猿ヶ京三国温泉郷のひとつ。キャンプ、渓流釣り等家族連れでも楽しめる。
review_summary:
People say this onsen offers a variety of baths, including open-air and low-temperature saunas, and delicious local dishes like catfish tempura and handmade soba. Visitors also highlight the reasonable prices, clean facilities, and the generally uncrowded, relaxing atmosphere.

Some reviews mention the service can be slow.
sales_point_en: Located within the Kawate Mountain Forest Park, this hot spring area is blessed with a beautiful natural environment. It is one of the Sarugakyo Mikuni Onsen areas, suitable for families with activities like camping and stream fishing.

name: 奥嬬恋温泉
location: 群馬県 吾妻郡嬬恋村
spa_quality: ナトリウム・カルシウム－塩化物泉
sales_point: バラギ高原に位置する一軒宿の温泉地。夏は避暑、冬はスキーが楽しめる。
review_summary: Guests mention this inn offers exceptional, elaborate meals for both dinner and breakfast, with highlights like ayu sashimi, yamame salt-grilled fish, and Jōshū beef fillet steak. They also appreciate the cozy, welcoming atmosphere, the presence of friendly cats, and the attentive staff. Visitors highlight the excellent value and the private, well-maintained in-room onsen baths.
spa_quality_en: ナトリウム・カルシウム－塩化物泉
sales_point_en: This hot spring area features a single inn located in Baragi Highland, offering summer retreats and winter skiing.

name: 尾瀬戸倉（片品温泉郷）
location: 群馬県 利根郡片品村
sales_point: 片品渓谷の最奥、尾瀬の南の玄関口にあたる温泉地。美肌効果が高いと言われる。尾瀬へのハイカーやスキーヤーで賑わいを見せる。国民保養温泉地。
review_summary:
People say this onsen offers a genuine alkaline sulfur hot spring with a distinctive slippery feel, leaving skin smooth, and provides amenities like shampoo, body soap, and free-to-use dryers. They also highlight the affordable 600 yen entry fee, convenient location near bus stops, and the friendly staff.

Other reviews mention the washing area can be cramped.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located at the innermost part of the Katashina Valley, serving as the southern gateway to Oze. Known for its skin-beautifying effects, it attracts hikers and skiers heading to Oze.

name: 小野上温泉
location: 群馬県 渋川市
sales_point: 吾妻川沿いに位置する温泉地。肌をなめらかにする「美人の湯」としても知られている。
review_summary:
People say this hot spring features a wide variety of baths, including two indoor tubs with different temperatures, a spacious open-air bath, and a sauna. They also highlight the affordable prices, delicious food, and convenient location right in front of the station.

Some reviews mention the facility can be crowded.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located along the Agatsuma River, also known as the 'Beauty Hot Spring' for its skin-smoothing properties.

name: 鹿沢温泉
location: 群馬県 吾妻郡嬬恋村
spa_quality: マグネシウム・ナトリウム－炭酸水素塩泉
sales_point: 湯の丸山の北東側山麓に位置する温泉地。国民保養温泉地に指定されており、保養・療養に好適。スキー場や国民休暇村がある。
spa_quality_en: マグネシウム・ナトリウム－炭酸水素塩泉
sales_point_en: Situated at the northeastern foot of Mount Yunomaru, this hot spring area is designated as a national health resort, ideal for recuperation and therapy, with nearby ski resorts and national vacation villages.

name: 片品（片品温泉郷）
location: 群馬県 利根郡片品村
sales_point: 片品川の上流に位置する温泉地。春から夏は尾瀬の拠点として、冬はスキー客で賑わう。自然環境に恵まれ、国民保養温泉地に指定されている。
review_summary:
Visitors say this day-trip hot spring offers clean facilities with excellent open-air baths, often featuring beautiful mountain views and comfortable temperatures for long soaks. They also highlight the delicious local dishes like maitake-don and fresh gelato, along with the warm and attentive staff.

Some reviews mention the outdoor bath can be visible from the changing area.
sales_point_en: Located upstream of the Katashina River, this hot spring area serves as a base for Oze in spring and summer, and is bustling with skiers in winter. It is designated as a national health resort, blessed with a rich natural environment.

name: 鎌田温泉
location: 群馬県 利根郡片品村
sales_point: 国道120号線と401号線の分岐地点付近に位置する温泉地。山あいの旧宿場町で、のどかな環境にある。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located near the junction of National Routes 120 and 401, set in a tranquil environment of an old post town in the mountains.

name: 上牧温泉(みなかみ18湯)
location: 群馬県 利根郡みなかみ町
spa_quality: ナトリウム・カルシウム－硫酸塩泉・塩化物泉
sales_point: 利根川の清流沿いに位置する温泉地。谷川岳の眺望が良く、閑静な環境にある。国民保養温泉地に指定され、保養・療養に好適。冬はスキーも楽しめる。
review_summary: Guests mention this traditional Japanese inn offers a variety of hot spring baths, including private open-air baths in some rooms, and a unique "Haniwa-no-yu" bath with a mural. They also highlight the delicious and plentiful meals, especially the charcoal-grilled dishes and local ingredients. Visitors consistently praise the attentive and friendly staff, who provide excellent service and hospitality.
spa_quality_en: ナトリウム・カルシウム－硫酸塩泉・塩化物泉
sales_point_en: Located along the clear waters of the Tone River, this hot spring area offers great views of Mount Tanigawa and a quiet environment. Designated as a national health resort, it is suitable for recuperation and therapy, with skiing available in winter.

name: 亀沢温泉
location: 群馬県 高崎市
sales_point: 榛名山の西側山麓に位置する温泉地。森林浴ができる程の緑に囲まれた露天風呂が特徴。日帰り入浴も人気。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located on the western foothills of Mount Haruna, featuring outdoor baths surrounded by lush greenery suitable for forest bathing. Day-use bathing is also popular.

name: 川中温泉
location: 群馬県 吾妻郡東吾妻町
sales_point: 雁ヶ沢川沿いの山あいに位置する温泉地。閑静な環境にあり、保養・休養に好適。「美人の湯」としても人気がある。
sales_point_en: Nestled in the mountains along the Karigasawa River, this hot spring area offers a quiet environment, ideal for recuperation and relaxation. It is also popular as a 'Beauty Hot Spring.'

name: 川場温泉
location: 群馬県 利根郡川場村
sales_point: 弘法大師が発見し、脚気に特効があると伝えられている温泉地。近くには川場スキー場があり、冬季は賑わいを見せる。
review_summary: People say this ryokan offers delicious meals, with many highlighting the flavorful rice dishes and a wide variety of food. They also appreciate the unique experience of moving around the expansive grounds via self-driving carts and a monorail, and the beautiful, quiet atmosphere. Guests mention the clean, well-maintained rooms and the pleasant onsen facilities, which are often uncrowded.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area discovered by Kobo Daishi, known for its effectiveness against beriberi. Nearby is the Kawaba Ski Resort, which attracts visitors in winter.

name: 川古（みなかみ18湯）
location: 群馬県 利根郡みなかみ町
spa_quality: カルシウム・ナトリウム－硫酸塩泉(低張性弱アルカリ性温泉)
sales_point: 赤谷川上流の渓谷沿いに位置する温泉地。ぬるい湯に長く浸る低温長時間浴の習慣があり、湯治向き。河原に面した露天風呂も人気。猿ヶ京三国温泉郷のひとつ。国民保養温泉地。
spa_quality_en: カルシウム・ナトリウム－硫酸塩泉(低張性弱アルカリ性温泉)
sales_point_en: Located along the upstream of the Akaya River, this hot spring area is known for its low-temperature long baths, suitable for hot spring therapy. The outdoor baths facing the river are also popular. It is one of the Sarugakyo Mikuni Onsen areas and designated as a national health resort.

name: 川原湯温泉
location: 群馬県 吾妻郡長野原町
spa_quality: 硫黄泉、塩化物泉、硫酸塩泉
sales_point: 吾妻渓谷を見下ろす断崖上に位置する温泉地。鎌倉時代の開湯と伝えられ、歴史が永い。自然環境に恵まれ、野生のムササビが見られることもある。
spa_quality_en: Sulfur Spring, Chloride Spring, Sulfate Spring
sales_point_en: Perched on a cliff overlooking the Agatsuma Valley, this hot spring area is said to have been established during the Kamakura period, boasting a long history. It is blessed with a rich natural environment, where wild flying squirrels can sometimes be seen.

name: 北軽井沢温泉
location: 群馬県 吾妻郡長野原町
sales_point: 浅間高原にある照月湖の横に位置する温泉地。夏は涼しく、ホタルも飛び交う。キャンプやウィンタースポーツなど、四季を通して楽しめる。
review_summary:
People say this onsen offers high-quality, natural hot spring water with abundant flow, featuring both indoor and open-air baths. They also highlight the quiet, secluded atmosphere, making it ideal for a private and relaxing experience.

Other reviews mention the facilities can be poorly maintained.
sales_point_en: Located next to Lake Shomizuki in the Asama Highlands, this hot spring area is cool in summer and frequented by fireflies. It offers year-round activities such as camping and winter sports.

name: 北軽井沢温泉
location: 群馬県 吾妻郡嬬恋村
spa_quality: ナトリウム－硫酸塩泉・炭酸水素塩泉
sales_point: 浅間山麓の高原地帯に位置する温泉地。一年を通してさまざまなスポーツや自然を満喫できる。
spa_quality_en: ナトリウム－硫酸塩泉・炭酸水素塩泉
sales_point_en: Situated in the highland area at the foot of Mount Asama, this hot spring area allows visitors to enjoy various sports and nature throughout the year.

name: 霧積温泉
location: 群馬県 安中市
sales_point: 霧積川の上流に位置する温泉地。標高1000メートル近い山峡の秘湯。湯治客の他にも、登山客などで賑わう。自然環境に恵まれている。
review_summary: People say this secluded inn offers delicious, abundant meals featuring local mountain vegetables, including tempura and hearty pork miso soup. They also highlight the naturally warm, soft spring water, perfect for long, relaxing soaks. Guests mention the convenient shuttle service from Yokokawa Station and the peaceful, historic atmosphere.
sales_point_en: Located upstream of the Kirizumi River, this hot spring area is a hidden gem in the mountain gorge at an elevation close to 1000 meters. It attracts not only hot spring visitors but also mountain climbers, blessed with a rich natural environment.

name: 草津温泉
location: 群馬県 吾妻郡草津町
spa_quality: 酸性泉、硫黄泉(硫化水素型)、含アルミニウム泉、硫酸塩泉、塩化物
sales_point: 白根火山の東側、標高1000～1200メートルに位置する温泉地。強酸性の泉質に特徴を持ち、効能が高く湯治場として永い歴史を持つ。高温の温泉に短時間入浴する「時間湯」が有名。大量の温泉が湯畑や西の河原に自然湧出している。
spa_quality_en: Acidic Spring, 硫黄泉(硫化水素型), Aluminium Spring, Sulfate Spring, 塩化物
sales_point_en: Located on the eastern side of Mount Shirane at an elevation of 1000 to 1200 meters, this hot spring area is characterized by its strongly acidic waters, known for their high efficacy and long history as a hot spring resort. The 'time bath' method of short bathing in high-temperature water is famous, with large amounts of hot spring water naturally gushing out at Yubatake and Nishi no Kawara.

name: 倉渕温泉
location: 群馬県 高崎市
sales_point: 榛名山の西方に位置する温泉地。長井川のせせらぎや柔らかな木洩れ日の中でゆったりとくつろげる。
review_summary:
People say this hot spring features a unique, concentrated golden-brown water with a distinct oily scent, and wide indoor and outdoor baths. Guests also highlight the reasonable entry fees and the staff's excellent service.

Other reviews mention the water can have a strong oil smell, which may not suit everyone.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located to the west of Mount Haruna, where visitors can relax in the gentle sounds of the Nagai River and soft dappled sunlight.

name: くらぶち相間川温泉
location: 群馬県 高崎市
spa_quality: ナトリウム・カルシウム－塩化物強塩温泉、塩化物泉
sales_point: 榛名山の西側山麓に位置する温泉地。露天風呂が完備されている。湯は茶濁しており、効能も高い。
review_summary:
People say this hot spring features a unique, concentrated iron and salt-rich water that leaves skin smooth and provides lasting warmth. Visitors also highlight the reasonable entry fees and the well-maintained facilities.

Some reviews mention the water can be strong and oily smelling.
spa_quality_en: ナトリウム・カルシウム－塩化物強塩温泉, Chloride Spring
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located on the western foothills of Mount Haruna, featuring outdoor baths. The water is tea-colored and has high efficacy.

name: 五色温泉
location: 群馬県 伊勢崎市
sales_point: 伊勢崎市東方郊外の粕川沿いに位置する温泉地。時間帯により湯の色が変化する。薬湯と言われ、飲泉も可能。保養・療養に好適。
sales_point_en: Located along the Kasukawa River in the eastern suburbs of Isesaki City, this hot spring area is known for its changing water colors depending on the time of day. It is said to be a medicinal hot spring, and drinking the water is also possible, making it suitable for recuperation and therapy.

name: 坂口温泉
location: 群馬県 高崎市
spa_quality: ナトリウム－塩化物泉・炭酸水素塩冷鉱泉
sales_point: 吉井町北西部、鏑川北岸に位置する温泉地。山あいの静かな環境で、保養・休養に好適。付近では、ヤマベ、ハヤなどの釣りが楽しめる。
spa_quality_en: ナトリウム－塩化物泉・炭酸水素塩冷鉱泉
sales_point_en: Located in the northwestern part of Yoshi Town, along the northern bank of the Kaburagawa River, this hot spring area offers a quiet mountain environment, ideal for recuperation and relaxation. Nearby, fishing for Yamabe and Hayabusa is also enjoyable.

name: 桜川温泉
location: 群馬県 利根郡川場村
sales_point: 武尊山の山麓、桜川の渓流沿いに位置する温泉地。スキー場も近い。
sales_point_en: Situated at the foot of Mount Buson, along the stream of Sakuragawa, this hot spring area is close to ski resorts.

name: 真沢温泉(みなかみ18湯)
location: 群馬県 利根郡みなかみ町
sales_point: 大峰山の懐、山あいに位置する温泉地。自然環境に恵まれ、閑静な場所にある。休養・保養に好適。
review_summary: Visitors say this hot spring facility offers clean indoor and outdoor baths, with some highlighting the smooth, high-pH water and stunning views. They also appreciate the quiet, relaxing atmosphere and the comfortable resting areas with tatami mats and kotatsu tables. Others mention the friendly staff and delicious homemade muffins.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located in the embrace of Mount Omine, surrounded by nature in a quiet location, ideal for relaxation and recuperation.

name: 猿川温泉
location: 群馬県 桐生市
sales_point: 赤城山の南東麓に位置し、渡良瀬川沿いの温泉。わたらせ渓谷鐵道の水沼駅から直結した温泉施設がある。
sales_point_en: Located at the southeastern foot of Mount Akagi, this hot spring is along the Watarase River, with a facility directly connected to Mizunuma Station of the Watarase Keikoku Railway.

name: 猿ヶ京（みなかみ18湯）
location: 群馬県 利根郡みなかみ町
spa_quality: ナトリウム・カルシウム－硫酸塩泉・塩化物泉
sales_point: 赤谷湖畔に位置する温泉地。三国山の南東側山麓にあり、景観が良い。猿ヶ京三国温泉郷最大の温泉地となっている。
review_summary:
Visitors say this hot spring facility offers spacious indoor and outdoor baths, including a unique "bona sauna," and many appreciate the stunning views of Akaya Lake from the open-air baths. They also highlight the clean facilities, the availability of a relaxing tatami area, and the friendly staff.

Some reviews mention the hot springs can be too hot.
spa_quality_en: ナトリウム・カルシウム－硫酸塩泉・塩化物泉
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located by Lake Akaya, at the southeastern foothills of Mount Mikuni, known for its beautiful scenery and is the largest hot spring area in the Sarugakyo Mikuni Onsen region.

name: 沢渡温泉
location: 群馬県 吾妻郡中之条町
spa_quality: カルシウム・ナトリウム－硫酸塩泉・塩化物泉
sales_point: 四万川の支流、上沢渡川沿いに位置する温泉地。古くは草津の仕上げ湯とされていた。保養・療養向き。
spa_quality_en: カルシウム・ナトリウム－硫酸塩泉・塩化物泉
sales_point_en: Situated along the upper Sawata River, a tributary of the Shimagawa River, this hot spring was historically known as the finishing bath for Kusatsu. It is suitable for recuperation and therapy.

name: 座禅温泉
location: 群馬県 利根郡片品村
spa_quality: ナトリウム・カルシウム－硫酸塩泉・炭酸水素塩泉
sales_point: 日光白根山の麓、丸沼高原スキー場に湧出した新しい温泉地。
spa_quality_en: ナトリウム・カルシウム－硫酸塩泉・炭酸水素塩泉
sales_point_en: A new hot spring area that has emerged at the foot of Mount Nikkō Shirane, near the Marunuma Kōgen Ski Resort.

name: 塩河原温泉
location: 群馬県 利根郡川場村
spa_quality: その他(フッ素イオンの項で該当)
sales_point: 薄根川沿いに位置する温泉地。フッ素を含んだ湯はきめ細かい肌をつくり、別名「美川の湯」といわれている。紅葉は絶景。
spa_quality_en: その他(フッ素イオンの項で該当)
sales_point_en: Located along the Usune River, this hot spring contains fluoride-rich water known for creating smooth skin, also referred to as 'Mikawa no Yu.' The autumn foliage is spectacular.

name: 塩ノ沢温泉
location: 群馬県 多野郡上野村
spa_quality: その他(メタほう酸・炭酸水素ナトリウムの項で該当)
sales_point: 上野村の北部に位置する温泉地。渓流釣りや紅葉が楽しめる。山あいの閑静な環境にあり、保養・休養に好適。
spa_quality_en: その他(メタほう酸・炭酸水素ナトリウムの項で該当)
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located in the northern part of Ueno Village, where you can enjoy stream fishing and autumn leaves in a quiet mountain environment, ideal for recuperation and relaxation.

name: 敷島温泉
location: 群馬県 渋川市
sales_point: 利根川沿いに位置する温泉地。周囲にのどかな田園風景が広がり、休養・保養に好適。赤城ICがすぐ近くにあり、交通の便が良い。
sales_point_en: Located along the Tone River, this hot spring area is surrounded by peaceful rural scenery, making it suitable for relaxation and recuperation. It is conveniently located near the Akagi IC.

name: 四万温泉
location: 群馬県 吾妻郡中之条町
spa_quality: ナトリウム・カルシウム－塩化物泉・硫酸塩泉
sales_point: 四万川上流の清流沿いに位置する温泉地。古くから胃腸の名湯として名高く、歴史が永い。国民保養温泉地に指定され、自然環境が良い。
spa_quality_en: ナトリウム・カルシウム－塩化物泉・硫酸塩泉
sales_point_en: Situated along the clear stream upstream of the Shimagawa River, this hot spring is renowned for its long history as a famous hot spring for gastrointestinal ailments and is designated as a national recuperation hot spring area with excellent natural surroundings.

name: 下仁田温泉
location: 群馬県 甘楽郡下仁田町
spa_quality: 二酸化炭素泉、炭酸水素塩泉
sales_point: 栗山川の河畔に位置する温泉地。四方を山に囲まれ、閑静な環境にある秘湯。夏のホタル、こんにゃくが名物。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located by the Kuriyama River, surrounded by mountains in a quiet environment, known as a hidden gem. Summer fireflies and konjac are local specialties.

name: 白根温泉
location: 群馬県 利根郡片品村
sales_point: 国道120号線沿いに位置する温泉地。ひなびた山の湯の味わいを持つ。湯量は非常に豊富で、日帰り客にも大変人気がある。
review_summary:
Visitors say this onsen features spacious indoor and outdoor baths with abundant, free-flowing hot spring water, and appreciate the comfortable floor heating in the changing rooms. They also highlight the relaxing atmosphere, free massage chairs, and complimentary tea in the rest area.

Other reviews mention the entrance fee can be expensive.
sales_point_en: Located along National Route 120, this hot spring offers a rustic mountain hot spring experience. It has a very abundant water supply and is extremely popular with day visitors.

name: 尻焼温泉
location: 群馬県 吾妻郡中之条町
spa_quality: カルシウム・ナトリウム－硫酸塩泉・塩化物泉
sales_point: 白砂川の支流の長笹川沿いに位置する温泉地。川床から温泉が湧き、川がそのまま天然の大露天風呂になっている秘湯。
spa_quality_en: カルシウム・ナトリウム－硫酸塩泉・塩化物泉
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located along the Nagasasa River, a tributary of the Shirasuna River, where hot spring water flows directly from the riverbed, creating a natural open-air bath.

name: 新鹿沢温泉
location: 群馬県 吾妻郡嬬恋村
sales_point: 鹿沢温泉の北方に位置する温泉地。標高約1300メートルの展望の良い台地にあり、鹿沢の温泉から引湯している。付近は高原キャベツの産地でおいしい野菜を堪能できる。
sales_point_en: Located north of Kashiwazawa Onsen, this hot spring area sits on a plateau at an elevation of about 1300 meters, offering great views and draws water from Kashiwazawa's hot springs. The area is known for its delicious vegetables, particularly highland cabbage.

name: 新中之条温泉
location: 群馬県 吾妻郡中之条町
sales_point: のどかな山村風景の中にある温泉地。浴場からは雄大な山々を望むことができる。
review_summary: People say this historic ryokan offers a magical atmosphere with its traditional architecture and multiple onsen baths, including the unique Genroku no Yu. Guests highlight the delicious, thoughtfully prepared meals and the exceptional, attentive service from the staff. They also appreciate the engaging historical tours and the overall serene, relaxing experience.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area nestled in a tranquil mountain village landscape, offering magnificent views of the majestic mountains from the bathing area.

name: 高崎観音山鉱泉
location: 群馬県 高崎市
spa_quality: その他(メタけい酸の項で該当)
sales_point: 高崎市街地を見おろす観音山丘陵に位置する一軒宿の温泉地。閑静な環境にあり、眺望が良い。特に浴場からの夜景は美しい。
review_summary:
Visitors say this temple features a breathtakingly large Kannon statue that offers stunning views of Takasaki city from inside. They also highlight the peaceful atmosphere, helpful staff, and convenient parking with a voucher system.

Some reviews mention the staff can be impolite.
spa_quality_en: その他(メタけい酸の項で該当)
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located on the Kannon Mountain hills overlooking Takasaki city. It is in a quiet environment with great views, especially beautiful night views from the bathing area.

name: 高山温泉
location: 群馬県 吾妻郡高山村
spa_quality: ナトリウム・カルシウム－塩化物泉
sales_point: 十二ヶ岳の北方に位置する温泉地。山々の間にあり、自然環境に恵まれている。
review_summary:
People say this hot spring facility offers clean, spacious baths, including indoor and outdoor options, and a sauna. They also highlight the affordable 600 yen admission for three hours, the delicious and reasonably priced food, and the availability of baby-friendly amenities.

Some reviews mention the indoor bath can be too hot.
spa_quality_en: ナトリウム・カルシウム－塩化物泉
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located north of the Juuni Mountains, nestled between mountains and blessed with a rich natural environment.

name: 宝川（みなかみ18湯）
location: 群馬県 利根郡みなかみ町
sales_point: 利根川の源流、宝川畔に位置する温泉地。水上温泉郷の一角で、渓谷に面した大露天風呂が有名。四季を通して人々で賑わう山峡のいで湯。
review_summary:
Visitors say this onsen offers expansive outdoor baths with stunning natural scenery, including river views and snowscapes, and provides bathing garments for mixed-gender use. They also highlight the delicious traditional Japanese meals and the attentive, friendly staff.

Some reviews mention the outdoor baths can be cold.
sales_point_en: Located by the source of the Tone River, this hot spring area is part of the Minakami Onsen region, famous for its large open-air baths facing the valley. It is bustling with visitors throughout the seasons.

name: 滝沢温泉
location: 群馬県 前橋市

spa_quality_en: カルシウム・ナトリウム・マグネシウム－炭酸水素塩冷鉱泉, 炭酸水素
sales_point_en: Situated along the Kasukawa River, this hot spring area allows you to enjoy the sound of the flowing stream and the view from the windows. It is in a quiet environment, with stunning autumn foliage.

name: 谷川（みなかみ18湯）
location: 群馬県 利根郡みなかみ町
sales_point: 谷川岳南側山麓に位置する温泉地。谷川沿いの閑静な環境にある。水上温泉郷のひとつ。登山やスキーを楽しむことができる。
sales_point_en: Located at the southern foothills of Mount Tanigawa, this hot spring area is in a quiet environment along the Tanigawa River and is one of the Minakami Onsen locations, offering opportunities for hiking and skiing.

name: たんげ温泉
location: 群馬県 吾妻郡中之条町
sales_point: 反下川の渓流沿いに位置する温泉地。山間の奥深い場所にひっそりと息をひそめる一軒宿の秘湯。四季折々の彩りを見せる大自然と、滝に包まれた自然体験郷はやすらぎとくつろぎを与えてくれる。
review_summary: Guests mention this traditional Japanese inn features beautiful architecture with extensive use of wood and offers a variety of well-maintained baths, including private riverside rotenburo and a large indoor bath with stained glass. They also highlight the delicious and thoughtfully prepared meals, featuring local ingredients. Visitors appreciate the attentive yet unobtrusive service and the overall comfortable, relaxing atmosphere.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located along the Hanjigawa River, quietly nestled in a deep mountain area. Surrounded by nature that showcases seasonal colors, this hidden gem offers a relaxing and tranquil experience.

name: 大東嬬恋温泉
location: 群馬県 吾妻郡嬬恋村
spa_quality: カルシウム・ナトリウム－硫酸塩泉
sales_point: 嬬恋高原ゴルフ場の東に位置する温泉地。大東文化大学のセミナーハウスになっている。一般開放もしている。
spa_quality_en: カルシウム・ナトリウム－硫酸塩泉
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located east of Tsumagoi Kogen Golf Course. It serves as a seminar house for Daito Bunka University and is open to the public.

name: 月夜野温泉(みなかみ18湯)
location: 群馬県 利根郡みなかみ町
sales_point: 三峰山の山裾にある比較的新しい温泉地。関越自動車道沿いで交通の便も良い。高台ならではの展望の良さが人気。
review_summary: People say this onsen offers excellent quality hot spring water with a smooth, silky feel, and features both an indoor and an open-air bath. Visitors also highlight the affordable entry fee and the availability of free amenities like shampoo, body soap, and lockers. Guests mention the simple, rustic atmosphere and the friendly locals who frequent the facility.
sales_point_en: A relatively new hot spring area located at the foot of Mount Mitsumine. Conveniently situated along the Kanetsu Expressway, it is popular for its excellent views from the elevated location.

name: 嬬恋温泉
location: 群馬県 吾妻郡嬬恋村
spa_quality: ナトリウム・マグネシウム・カルシウム－炭酸水素塩泉
sales_point: 吾妻川の河畔に位置する温泉地。閑静な環境にあり、休養・保養に好適。
spa_quality_en: ナトリウム・マグネシウム・カルシウム－炭酸水素塩泉
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located by the banks of the Agatsuma River. It offers a tranquil environment, ideal for relaxation and recuperation.

name: つま恋温泉

spa_quality: ナトリウム－塩化物泉・硫酸塩泉

review_summary:
Guests consistently praise this resort for its wide variety of activities, including golf, tennis, and archery, as well as its spacious water park featuring multiple slides. Reviewers also highlight the attentive staff and the delicious crab and eel offered.

Other reviews mention the food can be cold.
spa_quality_en: ナトリウム－塩化物泉・硫酸塩泉
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located along the Agatsuma River. It provides a quiet environment, suitable for rest and recuperation, with beautiful autumn foliage.

name: 梨木温泉
location: 群馬県 桐生市
spa_quality: ナトリウム・カルシウム・マグネシウム－塩化物泉・炭酸水素塩泉
sales_point: 赤城山の南東側山麓に位置する温泉地。森に囲まれ、近くに川が流れる静かな環境にあり、キジ料理が名物。
review_summary:
Guests mention this inn offers delicious pheasant hot pot and sashimi, with meals served in private rooms. They also highlight the attentive staff and the relaxing, warm spring water, which is ideal for long soaks.

Other reviews mention the building can be poorly maintained.
spa_quality_en: ナトリウム・カルシウム・マグネシウム－塩化物泉・炭酸水素塩泉
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located on the southeastern foothills of Mount Akagi. Surrounded by forests and near a flowing river, it offers a peaceful environment and is known for its pheasant dishes.

name: 奈女沢温泉(みなかみ18湯)
location: 群馬県 利根郡みなかみ町
spa_quality: その他(メタけい酸の項で該当)
sales_point: 迦葉山の西方、奈女沢川沿いの上流に位置する温泉地。自然環境に恵まれ、保養・療養に好適。国民保養温泉地に指定されている。
spa_quality_en: その他(メタけい酸の項で該当)
sales_point_en: Located upstream along the Najizawa River, west of Kashozan. This hot spring area is blessed with a natural environment, ideal for recuperation and relaxation, and is designated as a national health resort.

name: 温川温泉

spa_quality: ナトリウム・カルシウム－塩化物泉・硫酸塩泉
sales_point: 温川の流れを挟んで鳩ノ湯温泉の対岸に位置する温泉地。効能が高く、眼病によく効くと言われている。保養・療養に好適。
spa_quality_en: ナトリウム・カルシウム－塩化物泉・硫酸塩泉
sales_point_en: Situated across the Onkawa River from Hatonoyu Onsen, this hot spring area is known for its high efficacy, particularly for eye ailments, making it suitable for recuperation.

name: 野栗沢温泉
location: 群馬県 多野郡上野村
spa_quality: ナトリウム－塩化物泉・炭酸水素塩冷鉱泉

spa_quality_en: ナトリウム－塩化物泉・炭酸水素塩冷鉱泉
sales_point_en: Located along the Nogurisawa River, a tributary of the Kanra River. It serves as a trailhead for climbing Tenmaruyama, Ooyama, and Akaiishi Pass, and is close to a camping site.

name: 幡谷温泉

People say this hot spring features a unique lukewarm bath, perfect for long, relaxing soaks, and offers a pure, free-flowing spring water experience. Guests also highlight the friendly staff and the peaceful, natural surroundings.

Some reviews mention the bathing hours can be limited.
sales_point_en: A hidden hot spring at the foot of Mount Busson. It is a new hot spring area with a spring temperature of 50 degrees.

name: 鳩の湯温泉

spa_quality: ナトリウム・カルシウム－塩化物泉・硫酸塩泉

review_summary:
Guests mention this traditional Japanese inn offers a relaxing hot spring experience with soft, warm water and delicious, carefully prepared traditional Japanese meals. They also highlight the kind and helpful staff, and the peaceful, nostalgic atmosphere.

Other reviews mention the facilities can be poorly maintained.
spa_quality_en: ナトリウム・カルシウム－塩化物泉・硫酸塩泉

name: 花咲温泉

review_summary:
Visitors say this day-trip hot spring offers clean facilities with excellent open-air baths, often featuring beautiful mountain views and comfortable temperatures for long soaks. They also highlight the delicious local dishes like maitake-don and fresh gelato, along with the warm and attentive staff.

Some reviews mention the outdoor bath can be visible from the changing area.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area where you can enjoy hiking and climbing Mount Busson in spring and summer, and skiing at three nearby ski resorts in winter.

name: 花敷温泉

spa_quality: カルシウム・ナトリウム－硫酸塩泉・塩化物泉
sales_point: 白砂川と長笹川の合流付近に位置する温泉地。源頼朝の発見とも伝えられ、歴史が永い。静かな環境で保養・休養に好適。
review_summary: Guests mention this inn offers delicious, creative meals featuring local ingredients, with generous portions for both dinner and breakfast. They also highlight the high-quality, soft hot spring water and the clean, well-maintained rooms, some with private open-air baths. Visitors appreciate the attentive and kind staff, who provide excellent service and thoughtful touches.
spa_quality_en: カルシウム・ナトリウム－硫酸塩泉・塩化物泉
sales_point_en: Located near the confluence of the Shirasuna River and Nagasasa River, this hot spring area is said to have been discovered by Minamoto no Yoritomo, boasting a long history. It is suitable for recuperation and relaxation in a quiet environment.

name: ハルナ温泉
location: 群馬県 群馬郡榛名町
sales_point: 榛名山の麓に位置する温泉地。山々に囲まれた自然豊かな環境にある。保養・療養に好適。
review_summary:
People say this onsen offers a relaxing hot spring experience with a scenic view of Lake Haruna, and many enjoy the delicious local cuisine, especially the tempura smelt and soba. Visitors also highlight the reasonable prices for both day-use bathing and meals, and the friendly staff.

Some reviews mention the bathing area can be neglected.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located at the foot of Mount Haruna, surrounded by rich nature. It is ideal for recuperation and relaxation.

name: 榛名湖温泉

review_summary:
People say this onsen offers a relaxing hot spring experience with a scenic view of Lake Haruna, and many enjoy the delicious local cuisine, especially the tempura smelt and soba. Visitors also highlight the reasonable prices for both day-use bathing and meals, and the friendly staff.

Some reviews mention the bathing area can be neglected.
spa_quality_en: ナトリウム・カルシウム・マグネシウム－塩化物泉・硫酸塩泉

name: 半出来・吾妻温泉

review_summary:
People say this onsen offers a unique bathing experience with both gender-separated indoor baths and a mixed-gender outdoor rotenburo, featuring abundant, warm, milky, and salty spring water. They also highlight the reasonable 500 yen fee for day-use and the friendly staff.

Other reviews mention the outdoor bath can be cool.
spa_quality_en: ナトリウム・カルシウム－塩化物泉
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located along the Agatsuma River. It offers a quiet environment, ideal for rest and recuperation, and features outdoor baths.

spa_quality_en: その他(メタけい酸の項で該当)
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located at the foothills of Mount Haruna, in a tranquil mountain setting. It is adjacent to a golf course.

They also highlight the delicious, carefully prepared meals, especially the local cuisine, and the warm, attentive service from the staff. Guests mention the clean, well-maintained rooms and the peaceful, quiet atmosphere.
spa_quality_en: その他(フッ素イオン・メタほう酸の項で該当)

spa_quality_en: ナトリウム・カルシウム－塩化物泉・硫酸塩泉・炭酸水素塩泉

Guests mention the warm hospitality from the staff, including foreign staff, and appreciate the clean rooms and facilities.
spa_quality_en: カルシウム・ナトリウム－硫酸塩泉

name: 武尊温泉

name: 松の湯温泉

sales_point_en: A hot spring area located just before the Kanetsu Pass. Situated at an elevation of 1400 meters, it is close to ski resorts in winter. Open from late April to mid-November, it is closed during the winter season.

spa_quality_en: Acidic Spring, 硫黄泉(硫化水素型), Sulfate Spring
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located at an altitude of 1800 meters. Enjoy summer retreats and winter skiing. The open-air baths offer magnificent views of nature and are said to be effective for asthma.

name: 水上（みなかみ18湯）

review_summary: People say this onsen offers excellent quality hot spring water with a smooth, silky feel, and features both an indoor and an open-air bath. Visitors also highlight the affordable entry fee and the availability of free amenities like shampoo, body soap, and lockers. Guests mention the simple, rustic atmosphere and the friendly locals who frequent the facility.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located along the Tone River gorge, offering great views of the valley. It is the central hot spring area of the Minakami Onsen region.

name: 妙義温泉

spa_quality: 二酸化炭素泉、炭酸水素塩泉、塩化物泉

Visitors praise this hot spring facility for its panoramic views of Mt. Myogi and the surrounding town. They also highlight the affordable entry fee, delicious and reasonably priced meals, comfortable resting areas, and the availability of a good sauna and cold plunge pool.

Other reviews mention the outdoor bath can be poorly maintained.
spa_quality_en: Carbon Dioxide Spring, Bicarbonate Spring, Chloride Spring
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located within a hotel on the eastern side of Myogi Mountain, situated on a golf course.

name: 向山（みなかみ18湯）

Visitors also highlight the affordable entry fee and the availability of free amenities like shampoo, body soap, and lockers. Guests mention the simple, rustic atmosphere and the friendly locals who frequent the facility.

name: 薬師温泉

spa_quality_en: ナトリウム・カルシウム－塩化物泉・硫酸塩泉
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located on the northern foothills of Asama Kaku Mountain. It is situated along a gorge and is blessed with a natural environment, bustling during the autumn foliage season.

name: 八塩温泉
location: 群馬県 藤岡市
sales_point: 埼玉との県境、神流川の河畔に位置する温泉地。天然記念物の三波石峡は奇岩・巨石が転がり、見事な渓谷美を見せている。桜山公園では冬桜が11月下旬に咲き、観光名所も多い。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located along the banks of the Kanagawa River, near the border with Saitama. The natural monument, Sanbai Stone Gorge, features impressive rock formations and beautiful valley scenery. In Sakurayama Park, winter cherry blossoms bloom in late November, and there are many tourist attractions.

name: 薮塚温泉

spa_quality_en: その他(メタけい酸の項で該当)

name: 湯宿（みなかみ18湯）
location: 群馬県 利根郡みなかみ町
spa_quality: ナトリウム・カルシウム－硫酸塩泉
sales_point: 赤谷川沿いに位置する温泉地。古くからの湯治場として栄え、三国温泉郷の中で最も共同浴場が多い。国民保養温泉地。
review_summary: People say this hot spring inn offers excellent quality hot spring water, which is naturally sourced and continuously flowing. They also highlight the delicious meals, especially the flavorful white rice and the exquisite morning congee. Guests mention the staff are pleasant and the overall atmosphere is quiet, allowing for a relaxing stay.
spa_quality_en: ナトリウム・カルシウム－硫酸塩泉
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located along the Akaya River. It has flourished as a traditional hot spring resort and has the most public baths among the Mikuni Onsen region. It is a national health resort.

name: 湯の小屋(みなかみ18湯)
location: 群馬県 利根郡みなかみ町
sales_point: 胴元湖に注ぐ湯ノ小屋沿いに位置する温泉地。水上温泉郷最奥にある。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located along the Yunokoya River, which flows into Lake Doumoto. It is situated at the innermost part of the Minakami Onsen region.

name: 湯の平温泉
location: 群馬県 吾妻郡中之条町
spa_quality: ナトリウム・カルシウム－硫酸塩泉・塩化物泉
sales_point: 白砂渓谷沿いに位置する温泉地。宿は渓谷にかかる吊り橋を渡って行く。渓谷を見下ろす露天風呂が人気。
spa_quality_en: ナトリウム・カルシウム－硫酸塩泉・塩化物泉
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located along the Shirasuna Gorge. The inn is accessed by crossing a suspension bridge over the gorge. The open-air baths overlooking the gorge are popular.

name: 湯端温泉
location: 群馬県 高崎市
spa_quality: ナトリウム－塩化物泉・冷鉱泉
sales_point: 牛伏山の山麓に位置する温泉地。閑静な環境にあり、保養・療養に好適。地元の人々の利用も多い。
spa_quality_en: ナトリウム－塩化物泉・冷鉱泉
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located at the foothills of Ushikubo Mountain. It is in a quiet environment, making it suitable for recuperation and therapy. It is frequently used by local residents.

name: 湯檜曽（みなかみ18湯）
location: 群馬県 利根郡みなかみ町
sales_point: 湯桧曽川沿いに位置する温泉地。谷川探勝の基地となっている。冬はスキーを楽しめる。水上温泉郷のひとつ。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located along the Yunihiso River. It serves as a base for exploring the Tanigawa area. Enjoy skiing in winter. It is one of the hot springs in the Minakami Onsen region.

name: いこいの村涸沼温泉
location: 茨城県 鉾田市
sales_point: 涸沼の南岸沿いに位置する温泉地。テニスやプール、パターゴルフなどを楽しむことができる。大洗でとれる海の幸が人気。
review_summary:
Guests mention this hotel offers delicious meals, including fresh sashimi, high-quality beef, and a popular breakfast with sweet melon and clam soup. They also highlight the stunning views of Lake Haginuma from rooms and baths, and the friendly, attentive staff.

Other reviews mention the hot spring can be overly warm.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located along the southern shore of Karunuma. You can enjoy tennis, a pool, and mini-golf. The seafood from Oarai is popular.

name: 磯原温泉
location: 茨城県 北茨城市
sales_point: 磯原海岸に位置する温泉地。磯原海水浴場があり、夏には家族連れや団体客などで賑わう。野口雨情記念館。岡倉天心六角堂が近い。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located on Isohara Beach. It has a beach for swimming, bustling with families and groups in summer. Nearby is the Noguchi Ujo Memorial Museum and the Okakura Tenshin Hexagonal Hall.

name: 五浦温泉
location: 茨城県 北茨城市
sales_point: 風光明媚な五浦海岸に位置する温泉地。岡倉天心思索の建物、六角堂が近い。海は日の出、月の出、漁り火が絶景。
review_summary:
Guests mention this inn offers stunning ocean views from rooms, dining areas, and especially the open-air baths, which feature high-quality, skin-softening hot spring water. They also highlight the delicious, seasonal cuisine, including local seafood and ankimo hot pot, and the attentive, friendly staff.

Some reviews mention the rooms can be poorly maintained.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located on the scenic Utsura Coast. Close to the building where Okakura Tenshin contemplated. The sea offers breathtaking views of sunrises, moonrises, and fishing lights.

name: 岩沢尻観音温泉
location: 茨城県 東茨城郡城里町
sales_point: 赤沢富士東側山麓に位置する温泉地。舟型の檜風呂、つるべ井戸があり、山々の佇まいを感じながら季節料理が味わえる。
review_summary: People say this hot spring inn offers excellent hot springs, including renovated cypress and rock baths, and delicious, abundant meals featuring local rice and miso. They also highlight the welcoming and attentive staff, who provide exceptional service. Visitors appreciate the tranquil atmosphere, making it a perfect place to relax and unwind.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located on the eastern foothills of Akazawa Fuji. It features a boat-shaped hinoki bath and a bucket well, allowing you to enjoy seasonal dishes while taking in the mountain scenery.

name: 鵜の島温泉
location: 茨城県 日立市
sales_point: 西行法師が歌を詠んだほどの景勝地。大田尻海岸沿いに位置する温泉地。800年位昔から近郷の人々の湯治場として親しまれている。
sales_point_en: A scenic area where the poet Saigyo composed verses. A hot spring area located along Ota Beach, it has been a popular healing spot for locals for about 800 years.

name: 鵜の岬温泉
location: 茨城県 日立市
sales_point: 目の前が太平洋という恵まれた立地条件の中にある温泉地。夏は海水浴が楽しめる。太平洋が一望できる展望風呂が人気。９年連続利用率日本一を誇る国民宿舎として、全国的に有名な施設。
review_summary:
Visitors say this onsen features spacious and clean baths, including open-air baths with stunning ocean views, and offers a variety of delicious seafood dishes. They also highlight the affordable evening discount after 4 PM and the ample parking.

Some reviews mention the food menu can be expensive.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area with a prime location facing the Pacific Ocean. Enjoy swimming in the sea during summer. The observatory bath with a panoramic view of the Pacific Ocean is popular. It is a nationally famous facility, boasting the highest usage rate in Japan for nine consecutive years.

name: 大菅温泉
location: 茨城県 常陸太田市
sales_point: 里川沿いに位置する温泉地。閑静な環境にあり、保養・療養に好適。里川で釣りも楽しめる。
review_summary: Guests mention this traditional inn offers delicious, abundant, and freshly prepared meals, including local river fish and hand-cut soba. They also highlight the excellent hot spring baths, which feature skin-softening water and are often available for private use. Visitors appreciate the reasonable prices and the warm, welcoming hospitality from the staff.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located along the Satogawa River. It offers a quiet environment, ideal for relaxation and recuperation. Fishing can also be enjoyed in the Satogawa.

name: 会瀬温泉
location: 茨城県 日立市
sales_point: 日立駅の南方約1.5キロ地点に位置する温泉地。会瀬海浜浴場が近接しており、夏は海水浴客で賑わう。
review_summary: Visitors say this hot spring facility offers an open-air bath with panoramic ocean views, along with a variety of other baths like high-concentration carbonated springs and silk baths. They also highlight the delicious food, especially the fried cartilage, and the clean, well-maintained facilities. Guests mention the comfortable rest areas with reclining chairs and a good selection of popular manga.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located about 1.5 kilometers south of Hitachi Station. Close to Aise Beach, it is bustling with beachgoers in the summer.

name: 勝倉温泉
location: 茨城県 ひたちなか市
sales_point: 自然に囲まれた静かな保養向きの温泉地。
review_summary: People say this hot spring facility offers a variety of baths, including a natural hot spring, high-concentration carbonated spring, and open-air baths with scenic views. They also highlight the reasonable prices, with towels included, and the clean, well-maintained facilities. Guests mention the attentive staff and the quiet, relaxing atmosphere, as children under elementary school age are not permitted.
sales_point_en: A tranquil hot spring area surrounded by nature, suitable for relaxation.

name: 勝田中央温泉
location: 茨城県 ひたちなか市
sales_point: 体まるごとリラックスできる温泉地。
review_summary: People say this hot spring facility offers a variety of baths, including a natural hot spring, high-concentration carbonated spring, and open-air baths with scenic views. They also highlight the reasonable prices, with towels included, and the clean, well-maintained facilities. Guests mention the attentive staff and the quiet, relaxing atmosphere, as children under elementary school age are not permitted.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area where you can fully relax your body.

name: 上深荻温泉
location: 茨城県 常陸太田市
sales_point: 風光明媚な山々に抱かれた、谷川の清流が取り巻くせせらぎの湯宿。
review_summary:
Visitors say this hot spring facility offers a unique, highly alkaline water that leaves skin feeling smooth, along with a sauna and open-air bath with scenic views. They also highlight the clean facilities, good service, and delicious local dishes available at the dining hall.

Other reviews mention the parking can be on a steep slope.
sales_point_en: A serene hot spring inn surrounded by picturesque mountains and the clear streams of a valley.

name: 川中子温泉
location: 茨城県 常陸太田市
sales_point: 小目町近くの田園の中に位置する温泉地。閑静な環境で保養・静養に好適。源泉は飲用もできる。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located in the countryside near Kome Town. It offers a quiet environment, ideal for relaxation and recuperation. The spring water is also drinkable.

name: 北浦宝来温泉
location: 茨城県 行方市
sales_point: 北浦の東岸に位置する温泉地。ブラックバスなど釣りの足場として好適。車で15分程の距離に鹿島灘があり海水浴も楽しめる。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located on the eastern shore of Kitaura. It is suitable for fishing, especially for black bass. Kashimanada, where you can enjoy swimming, is about a 15-minute drive away.

name: 久慈温泉
location: 茨城県 日立市
sales_point: 茂宮川の河口付近に位置する温泉地。日立港、遊覧船発着場も近く、観光の足場に好適。
review_summary: Visitors say this hot spring facility offers an open-air bath with panoramic ocean views, along with a variety of other baths like high-concentration carbonated springs and silk baths. They also highlight the delicious food, especially the fried cartilage, and the clean, well-maintained facilities. Guests mention the comfortable rest areas with reclining chairs and a good selection of popular manga.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located near the mouth of the Shimonogawa River. Close to Hitachi Port and a sightseeing boat terminal, it is ideal for tourism.

name: 弘法大師温泉
location: 茨城県 日立市
sales_point: 南高野駅に近い田園風景の中に位置する温泉地。静かでのんびりとくつろげる。久慈浜海水浴場が近い。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located in a rural landscape near Minamikoya Station. It is quiet and perfect for relaxation. Kujihama Beach is nearby.

name: 小生瀬温泉
location: 茨城県 久慈郡大子町
sales_point: 袋田の滝の東側約2キロ地点に位置する温泉地。
review_summary:
People say this hot spring inn offers excellent alkaline hot springs with a smooth, skin-softening quality, featuring both indoor and outdoor rock baths. Guests also highlight the delicious meals made with local ingredients, the reasonable prices, and the warm, attentive staff.

Some reviews mention the bathing areas can be exposed.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located about 2 kilometers east of Fukuroda Falls.

name: 関本温泉
location: 茨城県 北茨城市
sales_point: ＪＲ大津港駅の西方約2キロに位置する温泉地。雑木川沿いにあり静かな環境にある。
review_summary:
People say this onsen offers a clean and relaxing experience with natural hot springs, open-air baths, and a sauna, all at an affordable price.

Other reviews mention the dining options can be limited, and the atmosphere can be affected by other guests.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located about 2 kilometers west of JR Otsu Port Station. It is along the Zokigawa River and offers a quiet environment.

name: 多賀温泉
location: 茨城県 日立市
sales_point: 河原子海水浴場が近い住宅地の中に位置する閑静な温泉地。日帰り静養客も多い。
review_summary: Visitors say this hot spring facility offers an open-air bath with panoramic ocean views, along with a variety of other baths like high-concentration carbonated springs and silk baths. They also highlight the delicious food, especially the fried cartilage, and the clean, well-maintained facilities. Guests mention the comfortable rest areas with reclining chairs and a good selection of popular manga.
sales_point_en: A quiet hot spring area located in a residential area near Kawarako Beach. It attracts many day visitors.

name: 大子温泉
location: 茨城県 久慈郡大子町
sales_point: 久慈川沿いに位置する温泉地。関東一の鮎の漁場として有名。奥久慈観光の拠点に好適。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located along the Kuji River, famous as the best ayu fishing spot in Kanto. It is ideal as a base for sightseeing in Oku-Kuji.

name: 筑波温泉
location: 茨城県 つくば市
sales_point: 筑波山の中腹に位置する温泉地。ケーブルカー登山口がすぐ近くにある。筑波山探勝やつくば市観光、ビジネスの拠点に好適。露天風呂からは関東平野を一望でき、眺望が良い。
review_summary: People say this onsen offers a wide variety of baths, including jet baths, an electric bath, and a herbal bath, along with a sauna and a spacious outdoor area. They also highlight the delicious food, with many menu options, and the clean, well-maintained facilities. Guests mention the staff are friendly, attentive, and provide excellent service.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located on the slopes of Mount Tsukuba. The cable car station is nearby. It is suitable for exploring Mount Tsukuba, sightseeing in Tsukuba City, and business. The open-air bath offers a panoramic view of the Kanto Plain.

name: 土浦温泉
location: 茨城県 土浦市
sales_point: ＪＲ土浦駅近くに位置する温泉地。霞ヶ浦探勝や周辺観光、釣りの足場に好適。
review_summary:
People say this public bath offers a wide variety of baths, including spacious indoor baths, carbonated springs, and a comfortable open-air bath. They also highlight the reasonable prices, well-maintained facilities, and attentive staff.

Other reviews mention the water pressure in the showers can be low.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located near JR Tsuchiura Station. It is suitable for exploring Kasumigaura and surrounding attractions, as well as fishing.

name: 出羽の湯温泉
location: 茨城県 常陸太田市
sales_point: 水府村の南部に位置する温泉地。山田川沿いの静かな環境にあり、保養・静養に好適。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located in the southern part of Suifu Village. It offers a quiet environment along the Yamada River, ideal for relaxation and recuperation.

name: トップサンテ大洋温泉
location: 茨城県 鉾田市
sales_point: 鹿島灘沿いの大沢地区に位置する温泉地。プールやトレーニングジムがある。日帰り入浴も可能。
review_summary:
People say this hot spring features a unique, very dark "kuroyu" (black hot spring) with ocean views from the open-air bath, and a sauna. They also highlight the delicious shijimi ramen and tempura at the restaurant, and the affordable pricing for seniors.

Other reviews mention the washing area can be narrow and crowded.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located in the Osawa district along Kashimanada. It features a pool and a training gym. Day-use bathing is also available.

name: 友の湯温泉
location: 茨城県 北茨城市
sales_point: 菊多浦に面した太平洋岸に位置する温泉地。砂浜に岩礁が点在して景観に優れている。夏は海水浴で賑わう。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located on the Pacific coast facing Kikutaura. The scenery is enhanced by rocky reefs scattered along the sandy beach. It is bustling with beachgoers in the summer.

name: 中根温泉
location: 茨城県 ひたちなか市
sales_point: 田園地帯にある保養向きの温泉地。
review_summary: People say this hot spring facility offers a variety of baths, including a natural hot spring, high-concentration carbonated spring, and open-air baths with scenic views. They also highlight the reasonable prices, with towels included, and the clean, well-maintained facilities. Guests mention the attentive staff and the quiet, relaxing atmosphere, as children under elementary school age are not permitted.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area suitable for relaxation located in a rural area.

name: 成沢鉱泉
location: 茨城県 水戸市
sales_point: 水戸市の北部、金砂山の山麓に位置する温泉地。水戸森林公園に隣接しており、素朴な雰囲気が残る。保養・療養に好適。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located in the northern part of Mito City, at the foot of Kinasayama. It is adjacent to Mito Forest Park and retains a rustic atmosphere, ideal for relaxation and recuperation.

name: 袋田温泉
location: 茨城県 久慈郡大子町
sales_point: 久慈川の清流沿いに位置する温泉地。日本三名瀑のひとつ、袋田大滝が近く、観光名所として賑わいを見せる。
review_summary: People say this hotel offers an excellent all-inclusive experience with a wide variety of delicious local dishes, including ayu salt-grilled fish and shamo chicken hot pot, along with free-flowing drinks. They also highlight the smooth, skin-softening hot springs, including a unique apple-filled bath and a scenic riverside open-air bath. Guests mention the attentive and friendly staff, who contribute to a relaxing and enjoyable stay.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located along the clear waters of the Kuji River. Close to Fukuroda Falls, one of Japan's three famous waterfalls, it is a popular tourist destination.

name: 水原温泉
location: 茨城県 潮来市
sales_point: 水郷地帯を一望できる高台に位置する温泉地。「かんぽの宿」の展望大浴場からは、見渡す限りの水郷の景色も満喫できる。
review_summary:
People say this hotel offers delicious and varied breakfast buffets, often featuring local ingredients, and many rooms provide beautiful views of Lake Kitaura. Guests also appreciate the complimentary lounge services with drinks and snacks, the free late-night tantanmen ramen, and the attentive staff.

Other reviews mention the food can be unappetizing.
sales_point_en: Situated on a hill with a panoramic view of the water town area. The large public bath at 'Kanpo no Yado' offers a breathtaking view of the surrounding scenery.

name: 矢田温泉
location: 茨城県 久慈郡大子町
sales_point: 大子町中心部に位置する温泉地。大子町営の日帰り温泉施設も好評。
review_summary:
People say this onsen features spacious open-air baths with scenic views, and unique seasonal baths with floating apples or roses. They also highlight the clean facilities, relaxing atmosphere, and reasonable prices, especially after 5 PM.

Some reviews mention the water can be cold.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located in the center of Daigo Town. The town-operated day-use hot spring facility is also well-received.

name: 湯ノ網温泉
location: 茨城県 北茨城市
sales_point: ＪＲ大津港駅の西方、丘陵地帯に位置する温泉地。鹿の湯とも呼ばれる。静かな環境にあり、保養・療養に好適。
sales_point_en: Located west of JR Otsu Port Station in a hilly area, this hot spring is also known as 'Shika no Yu.' It offers a quiet environment, ideal for relaxation and recuperation.

name: 湯の澤温泉
location: 茨城県 常陸大宮市
sales_point: 久慈川畔に位置する温泉地。天保年間よりこんこんと湧出し、昔から「医者いらず」の名湯として伝えられる。鮎釣りやキャンプなど、家族連れも楽しむことができる。
review_summary: People say this hot spring inn offers excellent hot springs, including renovated cypress and rock baths, and delicious, abundant meals featuring local rice and miso. They also highlight the welcoming and attentive staff, who provide exceptional service. Visitors appreciate the tranquil atmosphere, making it a perfect place to relax and unwind.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located by the Kuji River. It has been bubbling up since the Tenpo era and is known as a 'healing hot spring' that has been cherished for generations. Families can enjoy activities like ayu fishing and camping.

name: 横川温泉
location: 茨城県 常陸太田市
sales_point: 里河に流れ込む天竜川渓谷沿いに位置する温泉地。閑静な環境で保養・療養に好適。渓流釣りも楽しむことができる。
sales_point_en: Situated along the Tenryu River gorge flowing into the Satokawa River, this hot spring area is in a tranquil environment, suitable for relaxation and recuperation. Stream fishing is also available.
